tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gshin rje gshed dmar po'i shin tu spros med kyi man ngag gi khrid yig dang 'jam dpal thugs kyi ye shes 'char byed don gnyis lhun grub ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan saṅgu ru badz+ra ā tsar+ya mañju badz+ra ye na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rdo rje slob dpon chen po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed dmar dang / /dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag btsal nas/ /lha mchog gang gi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i khrid/ /'jam dpal thugs kyi spros med ye shes che/ /skal bzang rnams kyi rgyud la 'char byed pa'i/ /legs bshad tshig nyung don mang go bde'i ngag /'chad par 'gyur gyis don gnyer dga' bas nyon/ /de la 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa gzhung spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi sgo nas/ gdul bya rnams sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi dang / rjes gsum las/ de yang sngon 'gro'i skabs 'dir rje rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'i spros med mdzes rgyan las/ dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob cing / dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pa/ man ngag gi tshul shes shing / zang zing la ma chags pa/ snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ dad pa dang ldan zhing nyung ngu'i rnal 'byor la mos pa/ mchog gi dngos grub kho na don du gnyer ba'i slob ma dag yang dag pa'i lam la bkri bar 'dod pas/ thog mar mi rtag pa dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gtam gyis yid phyung / de'i 'og tu thar pa dang / myang 'das kyi phan yon gyi gtam gyis spro ba bskyed de/ gzod rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bkri bar bya'o zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar mi rtag pa dang / dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs bstan na ding sang gi gdul bya la khrid kha tshang ba'i yan lag tu 'gyur bas rung zhing legs mod/ 'on kyang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyi gtam gyis yid phyung zhes 'byung bas/

dmigs rnams su dril nas sgom ni mi dgos la/ bla mas mdor bsdus tsam re bshad dgos pa 'dra zhing / gang ltar yang ding sang / bla ma dam pa phal cher gyi phyag len la thog mar dbang bskur ba nas bkri bar mdzad pas/ de la dang po dbang bskur ba'i cho ga 'khor dang bcas pa ni rje rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i mngon rtogs bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / dkyil 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gnyis tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs pa'i sgo nas/ slob ma rnams dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du bcug ste dbang bzhi legs par bskur zhing / de lta bus dbang gis slob ma ma smin pa smin pa'am/ smin kyang lam 'di nyid bsgom pa'i snod rung du byas te/ de'i rjes su dngos gzhi'i khrid ston pas/ de yang dbang bskur ba'i phyi nyin slob ma rnams tshogs pa dang mnyam du bla mas bskul nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzla ru bcug tshar ba dang thams cad kyi thal mo sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas gus la bdag gsol 'debs/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /ces dang / sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ nyes pa dang / ltung ba/ dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub 'gyur nas/ /zhes sogs brjod/ de nas skabs 'dir spro na dpon slob rnams kyis brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gdangs dang bcas pa mdzad rjes/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'i bar la/ bla mas chos gtor bsngo dgos pas/ /de yang / hrīḥṣ+ṭā+-i brjod cing / de nas lag pa g.yas gtor ma la bstan te/ oṃ zhes dang / g.yon bstan la āḥzhes dang /

gnyis ka bstan nas/ hūm̐ zhes dang / bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas te/ hoḥzhes brjod/ yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pa dang bstun nas/ 'chi med rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bca'/ de nas lag pa g.yon/ g.yas kyi gru mo la 'jus shing / g.yas kyi lcags kyus tshul gyis 'gugs pa'i stang ka byas la/ in+d+ra yā di sa pa ri wā ra aṣ+kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes dang / de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ in+d+ra ya hrīḥnas/ phai ཾphaiṃ swāhā'i bar lan gsum gyis gtor ma bsngo ba dang / bdud bzhi po ni rnam par 'joms/ /dpa' bo gdug pa 'dul mdzad cing / /gshin rje mthar byed phyag 'tshal zhing / /phyogs skyong bco lnga'i tshogs la 'dud/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snom la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun 'grub cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi sdong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing phyugs 'phel ba/ /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /de nas lag pa gnyis bsnol ba phyir bstan pa'i mtheb srin gyis se gol gtogs la/ badz+ra muḥ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs zhes brjod/ de nas bla mas chos bshad 'di ltar bya ste/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i chos zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/

de la 'dir dpal stobs kyi mgon po rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rje btsun bir+wa pa'i dgongs pa dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi sgo nas gdul bya rnams sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid par byed pa la/ thog mar spyir dam pa'i chos byung ba'i lo rgyus dang / khyad par du gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ lo rgyus de dang ldan pa'i lam dngos nyams su blang ba'i yul gsum gyi sgo nas ston par byed pa las/ dang po ni/ spyir theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i dgongs pas/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas sangs rgyas su zin kyang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du/ dang por/ skye ba mngon par skye ba'i tshul gyis/ dga' ldan du lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar por sku skye ba bzhes nas/ de'i rjes su 'dzam bu gling pa'i skye dgu rnams kyi tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su/ rgya gar gyi grong khyer ser skya'i pho brang ngang skya ldan zhes bya bar/ rab byung zhes pa me mo yos kyi lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ yum sgyu ma lha mdzes gso sbyong la gnas pa'i tshe/ dga' ldan nas glang po che thal kar mche ba drug ldan gdong gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa'i gzugs su byas te/ yum gyi glo g.yas pa nas lhums su zhugs/ der zla ba bcu bzhugs nas/ sa pho 'brug gi lo dbo zla ba'i tshes brgyad la/ shing gzhon nu rnams dang / yid du 'ong ba'i me tog sna tshogs kha 'bus pa'i dus su yum gyi bkra shis lum ba'i tshal du gshegs te/ shing pa la sha'i sdong po la 'jus te glo g.yon pa nas gnod pa med par sku bltam/ byang chub sems dpas yum gyi tshe'i tshad mkhyen pa'i stobs kyi/ de nas zhag bdun song ba dang / yum sgyu ma lha mdzes de nyid 'das te sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes la/

de'i rjes su skye dgu'i bdag mo la sogs pa'i ma ma rnams la gtad de bskyed bsring nas/ bzo'i gnas la sogs pa'i mdzad pa rnams rim gyis mdzad/ mthar 'khor ba la nges par 'byung ste/ grong khyer ser skya'i steng nas chibs ngang pa gser ldan la chibs pa'i tshe rgyal po chen po bzhis bteg nas nam mkha' la gshegs te/ yul yangs pa can du byon nas/ mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du nyid kyi dbu skra nyid kyis bcad nas rab tu byung la/ de nas chu bo ne ran+dza ra'i 'gram du mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag ste lo drug dka' ba spyad/ de nas rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing drung du rdo rje skyil krung bcas te srod la bdud btul/ tho rang mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi bar du thugs las chung ngus tshul gyis bzhugs pa la/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis tshangs pa gtsug phud can la sogs pas/ bcom ldan 'das la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa phul nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab pas/ wa ra na si'am/ wa nar+si zhes pa phub ral can gyi grong khyer du 'khor lnga sde bzang po la sogs pa gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rnams la bka' dang po bden pa bzhi dang / gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can rnams la bya rgod spung pa'i rir bar pa mtshan nyid med pa dang / gdul bya ma nges pa'i rigs can rnams la/ ri ma la ya la sogs pa'am/ yul mnyan yod du tha ma legs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rnams rim pa bzhin du bskor ba yin pas/ theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyi chos 'khor de ltar du bskor nas/ da thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul ji lta bu zhig yin na/ spyir gyi 'dzam bu'i gling du mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston par mdzad pa sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'og min du gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa gsungs shing /

ma 'ongs pa na 'byon par 'gyur ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang gsung bar 'gyur la/ de ni 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /ma 'ong rnams kyang gsung 'gyur la/ /zhes pa'i don yin zhing / khyad par du shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid kyis 'jig rten gyi khams las 'das pa'i 'og min stug po bkod par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas nas ring po ma lon par yo ga de nyid 'dus pa la sogs pa'i gsang sngags kyi chos rnams sa bcu pa'i byang sems rnams la gsungs shing / de nas 'dzam bu'i gling du sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan te/ thog mar gong du bshad pa bzhin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas/ de'i rjes su ri rab kyi steng la sogs par ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum la sogs pa'i bsdus brgyud 'ga' zhig la bskyar bshad mdzad cing yang 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud rnal 'byor gsang mtha' rnams la ni bskyar bshad ma mdzad de/ sngon bskal pa 'jig pa'i tshe pha rol tu phyin pa dang / kyai rdor la sogs pa'i rgyud gzhan rnams nub pas na/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pas slar yang bzlas te gsungs pa yin la/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud rnams de'i dus su dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa na bzhugs pa rnams kyis nyams su blangs te ding sang gi bar du gnas pa'i phyir ma nub par yod ces 'byung ba yin la/ bye brag tu gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud rnams ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bdud btul ba'i tshe/ bdud kyis rgyu bsod nams la skur pa btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ngas bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i dang por 'di yod do zhes gsungs nas phyag g.yas pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la bsnun ma thag sa'i lha mos dpang po byas pas bdud pham zhing nyi ma nub pa na/

gshin rje gshed kyi skur bstan nas/ sdig can ma he la zhon pa brdzis te btul nas/ gshin rje gshed dmar nag gi rgyud rnams gsungs so zhes gshin rje gshed pa rnams zer yang / rje btsun rtse mo'i chos la 'jug pa'i sgo dang / spyi rnam gyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi skabs su ni de 'dra'i bshad pa ma byung la/ gang ltar yang gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud rnams ni shākya thub pas slar bzlas te gsungs par mngon la/ de ni/ da ltar 'byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /yang nas yang du gsungs pa gang / /zhes pa'i don yang yin pas/ des na spyir chos byung ba'i lo rgyus mdor bsdus pa de tsam zhig byas nas/ da khyad par du gshin rje gshed kyi chos skor rnams ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ spyir sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud sde rnams la/ rgyud tha dad kyi rjes su 'brang nas/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon so so dbye bsdu'i tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig gsungs kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang nas/ dpal stobs kyi mgon po dang / rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis bzhed pas/ rgyud sde thams cad bsdu na/ bya ba/ spyod pa/ rnal 'byor/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang bzhir 'dus par bzhed cing / 'on kyang / nang sel gyi dbye bas/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa de la yang / thabs kyi rgyud/ shes rab kyi rgyud/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud dang gsum du yod pa las/ 'di rnams thabs kyi rgyud yin/ de la yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud las/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis/ /rgyud sde rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de yang gtso bor gdul bya 'dod chags can rjes su 'dzin pa gsang ba 'dus pa'i skor/

zhe sdang can rjes su 'dzin pa gshin rje gshed kyi skor/ gti mug can rjes su 'dzin pa rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i skor dang gsum las/ da res 'dir gtso bor gdul bya zhe sdang can rjes su 'dzin pa gshin rje gshed kyi skor yin zhing / de nyid la'ang bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bzhugs su zin kyang / 'dir dmar nag gnyis su 'dus pas/ de la nag po'i rgyud ni 'jam dpal khri drug stong pa'i rgyud chen mo'i nang nas zur du phyung ba bsdus pa'i rgyud gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud ces bya ba ni 'di'i rtsa ba'i rgyud yin la/ bshad rgyud ni gzhon nu gdong drug dang / drag po mngon spyod kyi las tshogs gsal bar ston pa 'jigs byed kyi rtog bdun la sogs pa rnams yin zhing / dmar po la rtsa rgyud rgyas pa le'u 'bum pa yin kyang / 'di ni ding sang gi gdul bya rnams kyi spyod yul du mi 'gyur ba la dgongs nas/ au ḍi ya nar dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis rgyas btab nas yod par bshad la/ ding sang bod du 'gyur ba la/ gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa ste/ de yang le'u dang po nas lha lnga ma dang / le'u brgyad pa nas lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor ston pa 'di dang / yang phyis su bzang ldan chos sde 'debs pa po byang pa'i zhal ngo kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang du grags pas/ rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa'i rgya dpe zhig rnyed nas/ chos rje bu ston pa la bskur bas/ khong gis bsgyur zhing / rgyud de nas lha lnga ma ston kyang / da lta de'i lung ni mi bzhugs la/ /de ltar na rgyud de rnams ni rgya gar du sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i dus su byung ba yin mod/ da 'o na rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor la sogs pa rgya gar du dus nam gyi tshe byung na/ de yang sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo stong nyi shu tsam song ba dang /

slob dpon dpal ldan chos skyong byon zhing / slob dpon de nyid la ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rje btsun rdo rje bdag med mas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te/ snyan brgyud bzhi'i gdams pas grub pa brnyes pa'i mtshan rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor gyi yig cha mdzad pa la/ lha lnga'i mngon rtogs/ dpa' bo gcig pa'i sgrub thabs/ gtor ma'i cho ga ste bskyed rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag gi gzhung rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang / 'od gsal 'char ba'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga dang / bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi cho ga ste rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / 'khrul 'khor gyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba dang / gshin rje sgrub pa'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i las tshogs kyi gzhung gnyis te brgyad tsam mdzad pa yin la/ gzhung de rnams ni rgyud 'bum pa la brten pa yin pas/ da lta bod na bzhugs pa'i le'u bcu dgu pa dang / nyer gnyis pa gnyis dang ma mthun kyang 'gal ba ni ha cang med la de'i rjes su grub chen dpal 'dzin gyis rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa la brten nas lha bcu gsum ma'i bskyed rim las tshogs dang bcas pa'i yig cha brgyad tsam dang / de'i rjes su blo bzang snying pos mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi mngon rtogs dang / bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa ste gzhung gnyis dang / phyis su dar paṇa ā tsar+yas 'gro ba'i me long zer/ mdzad pa'i 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid bya ba'i gzhung gcig dang / bcu gsum ma'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung phran bco lnga tsam byung bas/ gtso che zhing da lta yongs su grags pa ni de rnams yin la/ 'o na gshin rje gshed dmar po'i chos skor 'di bod du nam byon/ der tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ 'di rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan yan gyi sku ring la ni bod 'dir ma 'gyur la/

phyis bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇa chen gyi sku ngo man chad la skad gnyis smra ba'i lo tsā ba rnam pa lnga'i sku drin las kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir gshin rje gshed dmar po'i skor 'di dar ba yin/ de yang bod 'dir gshed dmar gyi lam srol yongs su grags shing tshad thub pa lnga byon pa las/ dang po ni dpyal lo tsā ba chos kyi bzang po zhes bya bas dpal gshin rje gshed dmar pos dngos su byin gyis brlabs pa'i bal po'i paṇ+ḍi ta ni lang ka de ba ste bod skad du rnyog med lha zhes zer ba la/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ bir+wa pa'i lha lnga'i sgrub thabs sogs rgya gzhung mang po yang bsgyur te/ bod du gshed dmar gyi srol 'di dang por gtod/ de'i rdzogs rim shin tu spros med dang / lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang bka' ni de dus ma lon la/ 'di nas brgyud pa'i dbang ni lha lnga mar nges shing / 'di byin rlabs gzhan las che bas/ rgyal pos gnod pa sogs 'phral gyi gdon thog tu shin tu mngags pa yin ces kyang grags te/ rje btsun sga lo 'dol chung du bzhugs dus cung zad bsnyung ba na/ rgyal po zhig gis bar chad brtsam ste/ mgron btsun rgya dpe kong rtse gang khur ba gcig rga lo'i mdun du 'ong nas/ rgya dpe dge phyung ste mig sngar bstan nas/ khyod mkhas na 'di dag gi don smra bar gyis shig ces zer pa la/ rga los nga na nas khams bzi bas re zhig sdod cig gsungs pas/ de nas kyang mig sngar dpe ris yag yug shad shugs byed kyi 'dug yi ge la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyur/ /ces zer ba dang / mtshan mo gcer bu byas lha khang gi nang du rdza'i dum bu mgo la bzhag nga ni rdza khyung mgo yin zhes bsdigs pa yang byed pa byung ba dang / yang lan gcig rga lo'i ngur smrig tu byon pa'i tshe mnal lam du/ btsun rgan lham mthil brdol ba 'big gi khres po khyer ba zhig byung nas/

nga'i lham 'di tsam zad zad btsal kyang ma rnyed pa'i grogs po khyed da sdod rnyed pa re dga' zer zhing dga' mgu'i tshul byed kyin phyi bzhin du 'brangs ba zhig byung / de nas khong gis dgon par byon pa'i tshe/ yab kyi gsung gis mdangs ni 'byung po'i cho 'phrul gyi che ba la/ de ring dge bshes pa byon/ bgegs kyi bar chad 'ong nyen yod pas 'byung po'i phan pa ltar byed pa la thugs ma yengs par thugs dam gtso bor mdzod cig gsungs/ rga lo rang gi thugs la yang 'di lta bu'i 'byung pos phan pa ltar snang yang / phugs gnod bskyel bar dgongs shing / de'i gnyen por thugs dam la brtson par mdzad pas/ de nas kyang re 'ga' gnyen gyi tshul du bsgyur te/ skye ba mang por 'di dang 'dir gyur pa yin zhes skye brgyud sna tshogs ston/ re 'ga' gtsug lag khang yid du 'ongs ba sprul nas/ 'di ni bdag gi ste/ khyod kyis 'di'i bdag bya dgos zer nas gtsug lag khang gi bdag 'chol ba ltar byed/ re 'ga' ni mkhas pa'i tshul bzung nas/ kho bos gzhung lugs 'di la yun ring du sbyangs pas 'di lta bu'i mkhas par gyur pa yin pas/ khyed kyang 'di ltar gyis shig zer/ la lar ni rdzu 'phrul cung zad re bstan nas grub pa thob pa'i tshul byed/ skabs 'gar bya'i gzugs la mi skad 'don pas tho rangs 'dab gshog sdeb pa'i sgra dang bcas/ zla 'od gzhon nu/ seṅge rgyal mtshan/ 'od kyi snye ma zhes 'bod cing / yar la long cig lta rtog mdzod cig thugs dam mdzod cig gzhung bshor cig ces chos la bskul ba ltar byed pa sogs cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston pa'i byang chub kyi bar du 'gyur ba zhig yun ring po'i bar du byung ba na re zhig gi tshe rga los dpyal lo la gshed dmar gyi dbang zhu bar brtsams te thar par byon pas/ lam bar du yang de na re/ da ni yul du 'gro bar rigs so/ /yab dang yum la sogs pa na'o/ /de dag blta ba dang 'phrad pa la 'gro bar rigs/

dbang bskur phyis zhu ba 'thad ces smra'o/ /de la rga los phyis thub pa dka' da lta zhu ba rang legs zhes smras pas/ ngas de tsam du khyod la bsam nas khyod kyis 'di ltar byed pa mi rigs de bas da lta ldeng zer khres po'ang bteg pa na/ rga los de lta na'ang dbang nges par zhu gsungs nas zhu bar thag bcad pas/ kho'i khres po bskyur te/ yun ring 'grogs pa'i grogs pos bslus so/ /khyod ci bder gyis nga ni 'gro'o/ /khyod kyi bskyel thung gyis zer ba ltar rga los thar pa gling gi mo yan sgang khar bskyal bas/ de na rta gcig 'dug pa la bzhon nam mkha' la 'phags nas/ rta de seṅge'i rnam par gyur/ /khong rang dpon go rum zhes bya ba'i gnas brtan gyi rnam pas/ lag pas 'gram pa bskyor nas glu len gyin mgo bo se ye re re la brgal nas song nas/ de nas bar chad las grol ba yin ces kyang rga lo'i rnam thar las 'byung ngo / /de lta bus rga lo des dpyal lo'i drung du lo gsum bzhugs/ dges rdor dang phag mo sogs kyang gsan/ khyad par gshed dmar gyi dbang gsan pas bshad ma thag pa'i bar chad las grol ba'i byin gyi rlabs kyi rtags mtshan mngon gyur du byung ba de yin la/ des rong pa shes bzang la gnang / de nas rim gyis brgyud kun mkhyen bu ston pa sogs nas brgyud pa ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la bka' bab/ ngor chen gyis gshed dmar gyi sgrub dkyil sogs gong du bstan pa'i yig skor rnams kyang mdzad de cher dar bar gyur pa yin zhing / yang srol gnyis pa ni chag lo chos rje dpal bya ba dpyal lo las gzhon pa/ bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa las cung zad bgres pa zhig gi bal po'i yul du byon pas/ paṇ+ḍi ta niska lang ka ni gshegs/ de'i slob ma bal po ra wan+t+ra ste bod skad du gser bzang dbang po zhes zer/ la gshed dmar bcu gsum ma dang / lnga ma gnyis ka'i dbang gsan/ sngar gyi dpyal gyis bsgyur ba rnams la 'gyur bcos mdzad/

sngar ma 'gyur ba'i gshed dmar gyi gzhung brgyad tsam bsgyur te lha lnga ma'i dbang dar rgyas su mdzad cing / bcu gsum ma'i srol gtod/ lugs 'di ni 'gyur legs shing 'gyur byed nyid kyang mkhas par grags/ lo tsā ba gnyis kyis 'di skor gyi yig cha yang mang du mdzad do/ /lo tsā ba de nas g.yung phug pa rgyal mtshan dge ba/ lo tsā ba blo brtan/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seṅge / kun spangs chos grags/ ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de la rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan/ chag lugs kyi lha lnga ma 'di chag lo nas/ go lung pa mdo sde dpal/ gshong lo blo brtan sogs nas brgyud pa dang / shang pa tshul shes nas/ dpal gyi rgyal mtshan/ klog skya pa/ spang sgang pa nas ma ti paṇa chen sogs la brgyud pa gsum/ yang bla ma dpal ldan seṅge nas bu ston rin po che la brgyud pa sogs brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba mang po zhig gi dbang rgyun ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan cing / de nas brgyud pa'i chag lugs kyi lha lnga ma'i dbang rgyun deng sang gi bar du dar rgyas su bzhugs pa yin la/ yang lo tsā ba de nas brgyud pa'i gshed dmar bcu gsum ma ni/ lha lnga ma g.yung phug pa nas brgyud pa dang 'dra ba zhig dang / yang g.yag sde ba nas rga lo sher bzang sogs brgyud nas/ sa bzang 'phags pa la babs pa gcig ste bka' bab gnyis rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos gsan/ lam srol gsum pa ni/ chag lo'i rjes su bdag nyid chen po sa paṇa gyi slob dpon rtog ge pa da na shi la byon pa la g.yag sde lo tsā ba bsod nams bzang pos lha lnga ma'i dbang dang / bcu gsum ma'i dbang yang gsan par rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho las bshad pas na/ lha lnga ma'i brgyud pa ni/ dā na shī la gnas 'jam gsar/ rga lo/ rong pa sher bzang sogs chag lugs ltar brgyud pa ngor chen nas brgyud deng sang gi bar du 'phel rgyas su bzhugs pa yin la/

paṇ+ḍi ta de nas brgyud pa'i bcu gsum ma'i dbang ni/ g.yag sde lo tsā ba grub chen ze dmar ba/ bu ston rin po che/ lo tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal nas/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ de la ngor chen gyis gsan la/ gang ltar paṇ+ḍi ta des lha lnga ma dang / lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang gnyis char spel mod kyang / rdzogs rim shin du spros med ni mi bzhugs par grags/ srol bzhi pa ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi slob ma'i mchog lta bu yang yin zhing / 'phags pa rin po che'i bla ma yang yin pa glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyis 'gro mgon sa pa la gnang ba sogs nas 'phel ba yin te/ de yang glo bo lo tsā ba 'di 'khrungs sa glo bo yin zhing / dang po tshong gi lo tsā byas pas/ bla dgas su lo tsā ba zhes grags/ phyis ni gsung rab kyi lo tsā yang mkhas par mkhyen la/ gang ltar yab khams pa mtha' bzhi'i rigs yin pa zhig gi glo bor bskrun pa zhig yin pa las/ des bal por tshong la byon nas sog po dang / bal po sogs kyi skad shes nas tshong gi lo tsā byas pas khong la glo bo lo tsā bar grags/ khong gi thugs la ngas lo tsā shes rgyu med pa'i lo tsā ba'i ming 'di mi rung / de bas lo tsā don mthun cig bslab par rigs dgongs nas/ thog mar bal po bha ran+t+ra la sgra bslab nas lo tsā thub par mdzad cing / de nyid la gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma'i dbang yang gsan/ phyis pu rangs kyi sku mkhar nyi zung du paṇ+ḍi ta dar+pan bod skad du 'gro ba'i me long zhes zer/ ā tsar+ya spyan drangs nas rdzogs rim shin tu spros med kyi khrid zab mo 'di legs par gsan/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung gsum dang / dpal 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i gzhung bcu gsum po phal cher bsgyur te dar bar mdzad/ dar pan gyi 'tsho ba'i de kho na nyid kyang bsgyur cing / de rnams kyi man ngag rnams kyang thugs su chud par mdzad/

lo tsā ba nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'di skor gyi yig skor yang mang du yod de/ de lta bu'i lo tsā ba des rang gi sras 'gro mgon sa pa zhes pa la gnang / 'di ni lo tsā ba nyid rab tu ma byung gong gi sras yin la/ 'khrungs yul glo bo stod sa pa zhes par 'khrungs pas sa par grags pa yin par 'ga' zhig las bshad/ yang kha cig las 'di 'phags pa rin po che'i bla ma'i sras yin pas thugs dges dges kyi sa yod pa'i dam kha cig 'di la gnang bas mtshan de ltar du grags pa yin zhes pa yang 'byung ngo / /des mang mkhar lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros la gdams te/ 'di ni mang mkhar lo tsā bar grags pa mang mkhar khra tshang dang / dkar cog la sogs par bstan pa spel/ 'phags pa rin po che'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs/ de'i tshe mtshan de nyid kyang khong rang gis 'dod zhus ltar btags pa yin par bshad la/ de'i mang mkhar khra tshang ni thog mar lam 'bras pa blo bzang dkar mo sogs kyi gnas de nyid de de nyid kyang gnas cung zad 'phos pa deng sang bsam 'grub dgon gsar du grags pa kho bo cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi skabs kyi bzhugs gnas mdzad pa 'di yin no/ /lo tsā ba des bla ma dpal ldan seṅge la gdams/ des bu ston rin po che la/ de'i drung du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis gsan/ 'dis kyang spros med kyi khrid yig sogs mdzad/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis dang / jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal la gsungs/ de gnyis nas brgyud pa so sor gyes pa ni/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ jo nang phyogs las rnam rgyal/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ des mus chen sems dpa' chen po la gdams pa yin la/ yang theg chen rin po che'i bla ma dam pa'i drung du gshed dmar gyi khrid bka' gsan/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi rnam bshad sogs yig cha yang mang du mdzad de 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan la gnang /

de nyid dang sems dpa' chen po gnyis char la bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan te/ de ltar brgyud pa'i chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan nas/ rdo ring kun spangs pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho'i bar du brgyud/ tshar chen nyid kyis 'di skor la 'chad nyan rtsal du bton pa mdzad pa'i slob ma yang mkhas pa'i dbang po mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang / bo dong mkhyen brtse ba sogs byon pa las/ 'di gnyis char gyis tshar chen gyi gsung la zin bris mdzad pa'i gshed dmar gyi bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad/ khog phub/ spros med kyi khrid yig sogs cha tshang ba re re yod cing / mkhas pa'i dbang po mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho la mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyis 'di'i dbang / spros med kyi byin rlabs sogs dang / de'i khrid/ de dag gi rgyab chos rgya gzhung tshad thub bir+wa pa dang / dpal 'dzin sogs kyis mdzad pa/ bod gzhung ngor chen kun dga' bzang po sogs kyis mdzad pa rnams phyogs cig tu bzhugs pa'i gshed dmar skor po ti gcig tsam gsan/ rje btsun dam pa de nyid kyi drung du kho bo cag gis spros med kyi khrid smin rgyas dang / rje rang nyid kyis klu sgrub rgya mtshor gsan pa'i gshed dmar po ti yongs rdzogs kyi lung / 'di skor gyi spros med kyi byin rlabs/ 'od gsal gyi byin rlabs/ de'i yig cha rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lung / bdud rtsi byin rlabs sogs chos skor cha tshang ba'i bka' drin thob pa yin no/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di ni lugs srol gcig yin zhing / gzhan yang mus chen sems dpa' chen po nas kun chen po/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ rje lha mchog seṅge/ rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ des chos kyi spyan ldan lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga' don grub la gnang /

de'i drung du kho bo cag gi gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang / rje thar rtse nas nam mkha' dpal bzang gi yig cha'i steng nas spros med kyi lung khrid sogs thob cing / gzhan yang yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba'i drung du sa lo thams cad mkhyen pas gsan nas snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen sogs la gnang nas de nas brgyud pa yang da ltar bzhugs so/ /sa lo chen po 'di'i sgrub thabs dang / spros med kyi khrid yig kyang mdzad/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos kyang gshed dmar dpa' gcig gi sgrub thabs mdzad cing / lhag pa'i lha 'di la bye bsnyen kyang mthar phyin par mdzad par sgrub thabs de'i mdzad byang gis rtogs pa yin no/ /des na glo bo lo tsā ba 'dis gshed dmar gyi dbang dar pan ā tsar+ya la gsan pa'i bgros gang du yang ma byung bas/ lugs 'di'i dbang gi brgyud pa la dar pan ā tsar+ya 'dren pa 'di ji ltar yin brtag par bya dgos pa tsam du snang la/ bal po bha ran+t+ra la bcu gsum ma'i dbang tsam gsan zhes pa lo rgyus kun las 'byung bas/ smin byed bha ran+t+ra la gsan pa des go chod mdzad nas dar pan la smin byed ma zhus pa yin nam snyam ste glo bo lo tsā bas gshed dmar gyi dbang bla ma gzhan las thob rjes su dar pan ā tsar+ya dang mjal dus gshed dmar gyi khrid rdo rje'i tshig rkang dang bcas pa gsan/ des na 'di'i dbang bka' dang khrid bka' brgyud pa tha dad du byed/ dpyad par bya'o/ /srol lnga pa ni/ gshong rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi gcung po gshong blo brtan gyis paṇ+ḍi ta bi ma la shrī la lung blangs te gshed dmar gyi rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa 'di bsgyur te/ de'i lung da lta yang bzhugs pa yin la/ rgyud 'di'i le'u dang po nas lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor bstan zhing / brgyad pa nas lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor bstan par bshad/

bu ston rin po ches bsgyur ba'i rgyud le'u nyer gnyis pa nas mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha lnga ma kho na ston/ rgyud de na gzhan na med pa'i rdzas kyi sbyor ba la brten pa'i las tshogs shin tu mang ba zhig bzhugs par bshad do/ /srol lnga pa 'di la rgyud kyi lung bshad kyi rgyun lung tsam ma gtogs dbang dang khrid sogs med la/ des na de ltar bshad ma thag pa'i lam srol de dag las/ glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i khung btsun zhing khyad par 'phags par bla ma gong ma rnams gsungs pas de ltar du shes par bya'o/ /de bas na bod yul 'dir gru chen shrī dha ra te slob dpon dpal 'dzin nyid kyi dbang chog dang bskyed rdzogs kyi gzhung sogs/ gzhung phran rnams bsdebs pas de nyid kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa'i bcu gsum ma'i lam srol tshang la ma nor ba gcig dang / chag los bsgyur ba'i bskyed rim gyi gzhung la brten/ dā na shī la'i 'khrul 'khor gyi las tshogs gsal bar byas/ dpyal chag dā gsum las byung ba'i dbang bka' gsum dang / glo bo lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gzhung rnams bsgrigs nas brgyud pa so so nas byung ba'i lha lnga ma'i lam srol cha tshang ba gcig ste/ gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lam srol yongs su rdzogs pa gnyis deng sang gi bar du yang dar rgyas su bzhugs pa 'di yin no/ /da lo rgyus de rnams dang ldan pa'i lam nyams su blangs pa la/ spyir rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa 'phags yul du byon pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis gdul bya bkri tshul mi 'dra ba rab tu mang po cig gsungs kyang / rtsod med kyi grub chen dpal bir+wa pa'i zhal snga nas kyis gdul bya skal ba dman pa rnams rim gyis bkri ba'i phyir du gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams pa dang / gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams cig car du bkri ba'i phyir du shin du spros pa med pa'i man ngag gi de kho na nyid de/

gnyis tsam gsungs pa las/ da res skabs su babs pa shin du spros pa med pa'i man ngag gi sgo nas bkri ba yin pas/ 'di la smin par byed pa'i dbang dang / grol bar byed pa'i lam rim pa gnyis las/ dang po dbang bskur ba ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin cing / rten 'brel kyang de nas bsgrig dgos la/ khyad par du 'di lta bu'i lam rim pa gnyis bsgom pa la thog mar bir+wa pa nas chag lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur dgos pas/ de ni kha sang nas kyi gnas skabs su legs par grub pa de yin/ da de lta bu'i dbang bzhi pa'i lam rim pa gnyis kyis bkri ba'i tshul ni/ dang po bskyed rim la/ tshogs bsog pa dang / bskyed pa'i rim pa la sems 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa ltar gyi mngon rtogs skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar du bsgom pa ste/ de dag gi don rnams ni lung sbyor nas 'byung ba bzhin bshad cing / mdzes rgyan las/ slob ma rnams kyis kyang bsag sbyang la dmigs te skyabs 'gro nas ye shes tshogs bsag gi bar zhag kha yar bsgom par bshad kyang / deng sang de'i srol ni ha cang mi 'dug la/ gang ltar yang de'i rjes su sems 'dzin pa la/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa/ snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa/ zung 'jug byin gyi rlabs pa gsum gyi sgo nas ston dgos pas/ de la dang po bdag byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rim pa'am yang na cig car du/ /sangs rgyas rjes dran bsgom bya ste/ /gong bur gnas pa'i bdag nyid kyi/ /lus 'di gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /'di ni bem po ma yin la/ /sha dang khrag kyang de ma yin/ /bden min brdzun pa'ang ma yin no/ /tha mal ma yin ye shes sku/ /zhes sogs kyi don nyams su len pa la/ thabs dgu ste/ sems 'jog pa dang / rgyun du 'jog pa dang / glan te 'jog pa dang / nye bar 'jog pa dang /

dul bar byed pa dang / zhi bar byed pa dang / nye bar zhi bar byed pa dang / rtse gcig tu byed pa dang / shin tu mnyam par 'jog pa dang dgu las/ dang po ni/ sngar ltar skyabs 'gro nas ye shes pa 'jug pa'i bar gyi mngon par rtog pa bsgom nas de la sems cung zad 'jog pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgyun du 'jog pa ni/ gong gi de'i rjes su dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par spyan dbus ma la sems 'dzin pa yin te/ de yang rang gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i spyan dbus ma khro bo'i spyan g.yas pa gyen du langs pa lta bu/ dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba de 'dra ba zhig yid yul du gsal bar byas la sems bzung zhing / de yang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad la bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad la bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / de ltar byas te yang yang du bsgom pas gsal po rang ma byung na/ spyan dbus ma zhes sogs rang gi tshig tu brjod pa'i sgo nas kyang sems bzung / des kyang ma gsal na gzhan brjod du 'jug pa'am/ bris pa la bltas nas kyang sems 'dzin du 'jug cing / gal te ma bsgom kyang rnam pa wal wal byung na/ de yang bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas bum pa dang / snam bu sogs la sems yangs su bcug nas de gnyis re 'jog tu byas te/ de yang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ ces pa'i don spyan dbus ma lta bu dang por blo yul du gsal po cig byung yang / sems de la hril te mi gnas par rtog pa gzhan byung na de ni rnam rtog rkun po'i bdud ces bya ba bsam gtan gyi dug yin pas/ de'i 'phro bcad ces pa'i don yin gyi/ sems bzung ba'i gzhi de'i rnam pa gsal ba'i ngos nas de kho na'i steng du sems gnas te/ sems gzhan du mi 'phro na de ga'i ngang du ci gnas gnas 'jog dgos pa yin gyi/ de'i 'phro gcod pa ma yin zhing / mi gsal na zhes sogs ni go sla'o/ de'i rjes su rjes kyi bya ba rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/

spyod lam la 'jug pa ste 'di rnams la thun bzhir gcod pa'am/ ma bcad kyang rung ngo / /de nas nyi ma gnyis pa'i thun dang po la sngar gyi spyan de kha la sems 'dzin lugs snga ma ltar byas la bsgom/ des na 'di ni gtso bo yin la/ gzhan brgyad po ni 'di'i dmigs pa sogs sems 'dzin rnams kyi bogs 'don nam yan lag lta bu yin pas/ de nas gsum pa glan te 'jog pa ni/ shes pa phyir 'phro na/ nga'i shes pa 'di phyir 'phros byung snyam du dran pas zin par byas nas/ slar de nyid la lhan ne glan nas 'jog pa'o/ /bzhi pa nye bar 'jog pa ni/ spyan dbus ma lta bu'i dmigs pa gcig gi gsun zhing skyo na/ de ma yin pa'i dbu'i gtsug tor lta bu gang yang rung ba zhig thun re re tsam bsgom nas/ yang sngar gyi de nyid bsgom pa'o/ /lnga pa dul bar byed pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin la yon tan dpag tu med pa yod par shes pa'i blo gros spyod lam thams cad du dmigs pa gsal ba med kyang / rgyun du lha'i rnam pa dran pa'i sgo nas sems dul bar byed pa'o/ /drug pa zhi bar byed pa ni/ rnam rtog 'phro bas sems mi dga' na/ dmigs pa gang bsgom pa de'i steng du sems lhod de glod nas zhi bar byed pa'o/ /bdun pa nye bar zhi bar byed pa ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa mi dge ba'i sems skyes na/ de lta bu'i rnam rtog gi 'phro sbad de bcad nas dmigs pa la gnad du bsnun pas zhi bar byed pa'o/ /brgyad pa rtse gcig tu 'jog pa ni/ sems phyir 'phro na 'phros pa de ngo shes par byas nas dmigs pa de nyid kyi steng du sems rtse gcig tu 'jog pa'o/ /dgu pa shin tu mnyam par 'jog pa ni/ bsgom pa'i stobs kyis dmigs pa de dag brtan par gyur pa na/ ched du gtad nas ma bsgom par yang ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis 'byung ba yin pas/ de dag gi don ni mdo sde rgyan las/ dmigs pa la ni sems gtad nas/

/de rgyun rnam par g.yengs mi bya/ /rnam g.yeng myur du rtogs byas nas/ /de las slar ni glan par bya/ /blo ldan gong nas gong du yang / /sems ni nang du bsdu bar bya/ /de nas yon tan mthong ba'i phyir/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems 'dul lo/ /rnam g.yeng nyes pa mthong ba'i phyir/ /de la mi dga' zhi bar bya/ /brnab sems yid mi bde la sogs/ /langs pa don ni zhi bar bya/ /de nas sdom brtson can gyi ni/ /sems la mngon par 'du byed bcas/ /rang gi ngang gis 'byung ba thob/ /de gom pa las 'du mi byed/ /de nas de yi lus dang sems/ /shin du sbyangs pa che thob nas/ /yid la byed dang bcas shes bya/ /de yis de ni 'phel byas nas/ /'phel ba ring du 'gro ba yis/ /dngos gzhi'i gnas pa de thob bo/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshul de rnams kyi sgo nas sems 'dzin pa yin pas/ de yang dang po spyan dbus ma la sems 'dzin lugs mtshan nyid pa cig ma byung na 'og ma rnams la'ang zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa zhig skye dka' bas/ des na 'di la zhag kha yar ba la sogs pa bsgom par bshad kyang / deng sang nyi ma re las bsgom pa'i srol mi 'dug cing / gang ltar yang de la sems 'dzin lugs legs po cig byung pa'i lugs su byas nas/ gzhan rnams bogs 'don shar 'debs kyi tshul du byung bas 'di la thun bzhir bcad nas nan gyis bsgom par byed dgos shing / rjes rnams 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /de nas nyi ma gsum pa'i thun chung dang po la mngon rtogs bsgom pa 'dra/ de nas sngar gyi spyan dbu ma de kha la sems 'dzin/ thun chung gnyis pa la de'i steng du rtsa ba'i spyan gnyis khro bo'i spyan dmar zhing zlum pa/ dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba zhes sogs brjod cing sems 'dzin/ de nas zhal gyi sgros mche ba gtsigs pa dang bcas pa/ shangs kyi khro gnyer rnams la gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad pa sogs gong bzhin byas la sems 'dzin/ de nas thun chung gsum pa la/

/de rnams kyi steng du zhal gyi dkyil 'khor byin po snyan gnyis snyan shal ring ba dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis phyag mtshan dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ thun chung bzhi pa la/ sma ra dang smin ma dang / dbu skra khams pa gyen du 'khyil ba dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin tshul gong bzhin byas nas bsgom pa ste/ 'di rnams la chos thun cig byas la/ thun las ldang bar 'dod pa dang / /dang por dkyil 'khor bsdus la 'od gsal du bcug de las lang ste hūm̐ zhes brjod pas slar yang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab cing dag pa dran nas bzlas pa byas te dngos grub blang ba dang / smon lam rnams bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma bzhi pa'i thun dang po la sbrul rgyan rnams la sems 'dzin pas/ de yang mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcing pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpungs pa la brgyan pa/ dung skyong ser pos phyag gdub byas pa/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul pa brgyan pa/ stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas ser pos ske rags bcing pa/ pad chen dkar pos rkang gdub byas pa ste thams cad kyang phud kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ lce gnyis gnyis dang ldan zhing / mche ba'i myu gu dang bcas par gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad pa sogs kyi sems 'dzin/ thun gnyis pa la de rnams kyi steng du thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang / rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal la sems 'dzin/ gsum pa la zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs dang bcas pa/ bzhi pa la sku byin po sbom la rgyas pa/ yan lag dang nying lag rnams thung zhing rags pa dang / yum rdo rje ro lang ma g.yas gri gug sogs mngon rtogs ltar bshad la sems 'dzin du bcug cing / de nas nyi ma lnga pa'i thun chung dang po la sngar gyi de'i steng du zhabs 'og gi ma he/ pad+ma nyi ma me ri dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa la shar gyi gti mug gshin rje gshed dang /

lho'i ser sna gshin rje gshed gnyis kyang mngon rtogs bzhin bshad la/ de rnams kyang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad pa sogs sngar ltar byas la sgom du 'jug de nas thun chung gsum pa la nub kyi 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang / byang gi phrag dog gshin rje gshed gnyis kyang de bzhin du byas nas sems 'dzin cing / bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ba sogs 'dra/ thun chung bzhi pa la bum thod bzhi/ de'i steng du gzhal yas khang nas me ri'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bshad nas/ rim pa bzhin gsal btab la sems 'dzin lugs rnams gong ltar byas nas bsgom du 'jug cing / thun 'jog pa dang 'od gsal du 'jug pa man 'dra'o/ /de rnams bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i tshul rnams song nas de'i rjes su snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa dang / zung 'jug byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis ni nyi ma drug pa la ston pas/ de'i tshul ni/ de lta bu'i bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor gsal bar gyur pa dang / de gnyis kyi thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa de nyid la zhen pa spangs ba'i phyir du 'di bsgom ste/ rang gi lus lha'i skur snang ba 'di/ 'byung ba dang 'byung 'gyur gang du'ang mi 'dug pas bem po ma yin zhing / der ma zad sha khrag gi lus kyang ma yin la/ de phyi rol du bden par yang ma grub cing / yang smon lam gyi stobs kyis grub pa'i brdzun pa'ang ma yin la/ de ltar bden rdzun gyi spros pa dang bral ba/ dngas shing gsal ba'i zung 'jug gi skur gsal bar dmigs la sems bzung zhing / yang de lta bu'i sku de nyid tha mal pa ma yin pa ye shes kyi sku yin la/ de yang gzhan ma yin pas na bdag nyid kyi sems las tha dad med/ gdod ma nas grub pas tha mal pa spang du med/ ye shes las logs su med pas/ des na rang nyid yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi yin no snyam du sems bzung / de nas gnyis pa la/ snang ba byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ /'di skad gsungs te/

bdag gi thugs ka'i sa bon las/ /sa gsum 'od zer rab 'phros pas/ mthong thos dran pa'i spyod yul du/ /ma lus lus pa med pa yi/ /brtan g.yo'i dngos po ji snyed pa/ /dpal ldan gshin rje gshed dmar po/ /khams gsum min 'dir gzhal yas khang / /srog chags min 'dir rgyal ba rnams/ /phung po khams dang skye mched min/ /khams rnams min 'dir dkyil 'khor pa/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsgom pa ni/ rang gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal ba'i thugs rje'i hūm̐ las khams gsum khyab pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ mthong thos dran pa'i yul du gyur pa'i brtan g.yo'i snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ gdod ma nas grub pa de gsal bar byas te/ snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad gzhal yas khang dang / bcud kyi sems can gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal bar bsgom ste/ 'gro ba thams cad rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas yin pa la/ su zhig la sdang zhing chags/ blang dor dang / bde sdug dang / skye 'chi sogs su la yod de med snyam du bsgom mo/ /de nas gsum pa zung 'jug byin gyis brlab pa ni/ yang 'di ltar du bshad de/ me long la ni gzugs brnyan ltar/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin ni/ /rmi lam ji bzhin goms byas te/ /bar ma'i srid pa rab sbyor ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang ste/ bdag dang snod bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi dkyil 'khor du gsal ba de yang me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar me long la rang bzhin med pa/ srid pa bar do ltar gsal la thogs pa med pa de yang ngo bo ma grub pa'i phyir bden pa yang ma yin cing / gsal snang ma 'gags pa'i phyir brdzun pa yang ma yin pas na gsal stong zung 'jug yin snyam du bsgom pa yin la/ 'di rnams la ni thun bzhi'i grangs nges mi dgos shing / de ltar na bskyed rim gyi khrid 'di ni/

rdzogs rim gyi rten yin pa'i phyir sngon du 'gro dgos la/ stong pa nyid la zhen pa kha cig bskyed rim ni rtog pa'i bsgom pa yin pas 'dis ci zhig bya zer ba de dag gis ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi gnad ma go ba yin te/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs kyi 'bras bu sku gnyis mngon du byed pa la/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsag dgos pas/ de la bskyed rim ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa'i dngos gzhi yin pa'i phyir zhes sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pas/ de ltar na shin du spros med kyi man ngag 'di/ spyir gang zag dbang po rab kyi chos yin kyang / ding sang gi so so skye bo'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis so so skye bo'i slob ma las dang po rnams man ngag 'dis khrid par byed pa la yang / 'di lta bu'i bskyed rim gyi khrid sngon du btang nas/ de'i rjes su rdzogs rim gyi khrid ston dgos pas/ de yang bskyed rim gyi khrid rnams rdzogs pa'i nyin/ chos thun de ga'i mjug tu khrid kyi sngon 'gro'i bsags sbyangs 'bog pa'am/ yang na de'i phyi nyin ston pas/ de yang bla mas 'di skad gsungs te/ 'dir dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab zab mo mdo sde dang / rgyud sde thams cad kyi nyams len gyi gnad bsdus pa/ grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i gsung rab/ skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams 'chi ba med pa'i gnas su khrid par byed pa shin du spros pa med ma'i gdam ngag gi khrid ston par byed la/ gang gis khrid par byed pa'i slob dpon/ gzhung las/ 'jig rten gsum ni rnyed dka' ba'i/ /bla ma mchog gi bka' dran gyis/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba ni/ /bla ma nye bar ston par bshad/ /shin du 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du/ /'jig rten chos 'phel blta med pa'i/ /rnam rtog kun spangs dpa' bo yi/

/dogs pa med pa bsgrub par bya/ /blo gros mchog ldan sgrub pa po/ /gza' skar tshes grangs 'dir med de/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /phyi rol bkod pa 'dir mi dgos/ /bsam gtan bzlas pa yod ma yin/ /bsreg lugs dang ni gtor ma med/ /phyag rgya bcing dang 'khrul 'khor sogs/ /phyi rol g.yeng pa kun spangs te/ /ces gsungs pas/ 'di'i gdam ngag la mkhas shing / gdam ngag thob la ma nyams pa/ /nyams myong ci rigs pa rgyud la skyes pa cig gis khrid par byed dgos shing / gang khrid par byed na gdul bya'i rgyud kyi sems nyid rig pa gsal la ma 'gags pa de khrid par byed la/ de thabs gang gis khrid par byed na/ 'di lta bu'i thabs khyad par can shin tu spros pa med pa'i gdam ngag gi sgo nas khrid par byed cing / de lta bu'i gdam ngag gis gang du khrid par byed na/ 'bras bu sku lnga ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar khrid par byed la/ der gang zag ji lta bu zhig khrid na/ 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la ha cang ma ltos pa phyi rol gyi spros pa phar chod pa'i gdul bya zhig khrid pa yin zhing / gang zag de bsam pa ji lta bu zhig gis sgos khrid na/ de yang / gzhung las/ brtse ldan gzhan gyi don sems pa/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas/ /skad cig nyid la dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhes 'byung bas/ gdul bya de la brtse ba snying rje chen pos kun nas blangs te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs la brten nas myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed dgos snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas khrid par byed dgos pas/ des na chos de rnams dang ldan par byas te/ da tshul ji ltar du khrid par byed na/ 'di la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro la/ tshogs gsog par byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor dang / sdig pa 'dag par byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor dang /

byin rlabs myur du 'jug par 'gyur ba'i phyir bla ma la gus par bya ba dang gsum gyis sgo nas ston pa la/ dang po tshogs gsog pa maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ thog mar bla ma lhar bcas la/ /maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba btab/ /ces 'byung bas na/ de yang do nub nas bzung ste/ /khyed rang rnams kyi sgrub khang du stegs mtho bar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa cig bshams la/ de'i mdun du mchod pa ji tsam 'byor pa phyag len bzhin bshams shing / rang gi mdun du yang las kyi maṇ+ḍal dang / 'bul rgyu'i me tog dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa rnams 'dus byas la/ de nas rang rten la kha phyogs par stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ skyabs yul dngos su gsal 'debs mi dgos par/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa rnams yid la dran bzhin pa'i ngang nas/ skyabs 'gro khyad par bzhi ldan bya ste/ de yang yul gyi khyad par bla ma gtso bor gyur pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ rgyu'i khyad par brtse ba snying rje chen pos kun nas bslang ste ched du bya ba'i khyad par khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bskyabs par 'dod pas/ dus kyi khyad par 'di nas bzung ste sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar la/ rang dang pha mas gtso byas pa'i sems can kyis skyabs su 'gro bar mos nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro bzhi skor lan bdun la sogs pa ci rigs pa byas nas/ de'i rjes su bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnams pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/

/khyed rnams kyi/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o zhes pa'i sems bskyed tshar gsum byas la/ de nas mdun gyi tshom bu dbus ma'i steng du seṅge'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ gsung yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ thugs shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pas bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' skor du dpal bir+wa pa la sogs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ mdun gyi tshom bu la dpag bsam gyi sdong po'i steng du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma la sogs pa so so'i gdan la gshin rje gshed/ 'khor lo bdag po la sogs pa'i yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs/ g.yas kyi tshom bu'i steng du seṅge'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la mi bskyod pa la sogs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang / shākya'i rgyal po la sogs pa sprul pa'i sku ste phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / rgyab kyi tshom bu'i steng du rin po che'i khri gos dar sna tshogs kyis bkab pa'i steng du/ lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i rang bzhin chos po ti brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu/ g.yon gyi tshom bu la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 'jam dpal dang / spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i cha byad rnams dang / shā ri bu dang mau'u 'gal gyi bu la sogs pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i rnam pa can bzhugs shing / de dag thams cad kyi mtha' bskor du chos srung nor lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa/

zhes ngag tu brjod cing gsal btab la/ de nas skabs 'dir spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang yang rung ba gdangs dang bcas pas gsol ba btab/ de'i rjes su/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag gi rgyud la spros med kyi ye shes skye bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes pa tshar gsum byas la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ thog mar rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams la dmigs nas/ rang gi mtheb srin gnyis kyi bar du nas bzung la/ lhag ma rnams kyis dri'i chu nas blangs te/ oṃ badz+ra bhu mi sogs brjod pa dang / thog mar dbus nas brtsam ste dbang ldan gyi bar du dri'i chu dang bcas te 'then/ de nas badz+ra rā ge sogs dang g.yas bskor gyi gru bzhir 'then/ phyi lcags ri sogs brjod pa dang / zlum por byugs te khye ma med par byas la/ de nas mtheb mdzub kyis nas tshon pa cig maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su gnas srung gi tshul du bzhag la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bgegs bsal/ de nas dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri rab sogs brjod cing / dbus dang phyogs bzhi/ dbus kyi mdun rgyab gnyis su tshom bu re bkod la/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /bzhes nas byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /tshar bdun nam gsum la sogs pa byas pa'i mthar/ bdag gi rgyud la spros med kyi ye shes skye bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes brjod/ de nas yi dam la dmigs nas tshar gsum dang / de bzhin du dkon mchog gsum dang / chos skyong srung ma rnams la tshar gsum re phul nas/ mthar gsol ba 'debs pa gong dang 'dra ba byas te/ de 'dra ba tshar re re byas pa'i maṇ+ḍal skabs dang bstun nas phul rjes/

bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag gi rgyud la spros med kyi ye shes khyad par can skye bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ chos skyong nor lha rnams 'od du zhu nas dkon mchog gsum dang / yi dam la thim/ de rnams brgyud pa'i bla ma la thim/ de yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim zhing / de la yid kyis gus 'dud drag po dung pa byas pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam la 'od gsal rtog med kyi ngang du cung zad bzhag go /de nas rtog pa'i spun lang byung na/ chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ /'gro la snying rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /thabs mkhas spyod pa mtha' yas pas/ /yul dang dngos po byed pa po/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin med pas/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la 'bad/ /ces brjod/ de nas gnyis pa sdig pa sbyong ba yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ gsang sngags rgyal po rjes dran pas/ /sems can dag cing las rung 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ maṇ+ḍal phul ba'i mjug de ga la bya ste/ de yang 'di pa'i lugs kyis skabs 'dir rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor mi bsgom par/ rang gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i snying gar zla ba'i dbus su hūm̐ dkar po/ de'i mtha' bskor du yi ge brgya pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang / rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang / rkang mthil gnyis nas thon te/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos kheng par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ phyag 'tshal bstod cing phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /gus pas gus la bdag gsol 'debs/

/rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgrubs shig /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes brjod cing / mthar snying ga'i yig 'bru rnams zhu nas hūm̐ la thim zhing / hūm̐ yig kyang 'od du zhu nas lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bar bsam la/ bde stong gi ngang la bzhag de las lang ste/ dge ba 'di yis sogs kyi smon lam btab nas/ spyod lam la 'jug par byed dgos so zhes pa rnams bla mas ngag tu tshang mar brjod cing / slob mas kyang de bzhin du zhag kha yar gyi bar la byed par bshad kyang / ding sang ni zhag cig tsam gyi bar la nyams su len pa'i srol las phal cher la mi 'dug go /de nas gsum pa bla ma la gus par bya ba ni/ de ga'i mjug tu gsungs pas/ de yang gzhung las/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par ni mi bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ 'di ltar bsam par bya ste/ de yang don dang don ma yin pa shes par byas nas lam la 'jug dgos pa yin la/ don dang don ma yin pa de rang gis mi phyed cing / bla ma la rag las dgos pas/ des na bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed nas gus par bya dgos te/ sangs rgyas rnams la sems can gyi don kho na las mdzad rgyu med na'ang / sangs rgyas dngos kyis rang re rnams la chos gsungs kyang de go ba'am/ zhal bstan na'ang ji ltar mthong cha med pas/ lam ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa yin no/ /rnam pa phal pa'i gzugs su bstan kyang / ngo bo sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin par lung rigs man ngag gsum gyis shes te/ de la dang po lung ni/ sam+bu ṭi las/

bla ma'i mos gus tsam gyis ni/ /dngos grub dam pa thob par 'gyur/ /bla ma dman pa'i sems kyi ni/ /dngos grub dam pa 'byung ba min/ /zhes dang / rdo rje gur las/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i slob dpon la ji ltar lta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /slob dpon ston par gyur pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad pa/ /bdag cag rnams kyi pha dang ma/ /de nyid yin par shes par bya/ /zhes dang / 'dus pa las/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la mchod pa'i bsod nams ni/ bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig la mthong ngo zhes dang / 'khor lo bde mchog gi rgyud las/ mchod pa thams cad spangs nas ni/ /bla ma'i mchod pa rab tu brtsams/ /de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi/ /yi shes gzigs pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las kyang / gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /nam du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / de rnams kyi don slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pas kyang / bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa la/ mdo sdud pa las kyang / slob ma bzang po bla ma gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci'i phyir zhe na rgyal ba'i yon tan de las 'byung / zhes pa dang / sangs rgyas phal po che'i mdo las kyang / tshong dpon nor bzang gi bus bla ma bsten pa'i skabs su rgyas par gsungs pas/ de ltar na/ mdo rgyud rnams las bla ma bsten dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan mang du gsungs shing / rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ spyir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod kyang / da lta rang re rnams dang mi 'jal bas/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs dngos su 'jug pa dka' la/

des na bla ma ni sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo yin pas/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs bla ma la bsdus nas gsol ba btab na byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa yin te/ dper na nyi ma ji ltar tsha yang / spra ba la me mi 'byung la/ nyi ma'i 'od zer me long g.ya' dag pa'am/ me shel la bsdus nas spra ba la glan na me myur du 'byung ba de bzhin du/ rang gi rgyud la byin rlabs zhugs nas spros med kyi ye shes skye ba yang / bla ma kho na la brten nas byung ba yin no zhes bshad cing nges shes bskyed du bcug des na man ngag gis kyang grub ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sngon gyi grub pa thob pa'i skyes chen rnams kyang / bla ma kho na la brten nas sgrib gnyis spangs te/ dngos grub dang yon tan thams cad thob pa myong bas grub pas/ des na/ don la bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin kyang / da lta rang las ma dag pa'i dbang gis tha mal par snang ba yin te/ dper na dang po slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis rje btsun 'jam dbyangs khyim btsun nya tshong byed par mthong ba dang / jo bo nā ro ta pas/ grub chen ti lo pas nya gson por bsregs nas za ba dang / lū hi pas/ sha ba ri dbang phyug bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa gsod pa'i rngon par mthong yang / de rnams kyis bla ma la mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgo nas zhabs tog tshul bzhin du byas pas bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs nas dngos grub thob pa yin pas/ 'o skol rnams kyis kyang / bla ma la mos gus bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgo nas/ tha mal pa'i 'du shes spangs te/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas bsgom ste gsol ba 'debs dgos pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ khyad par du yang shin tu spros pa med pa'i ye shes skye bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes gsol ba mang du btab nas/

thun 'jog par 'dod pa dang / bla ma rang la bstim pa sogs gang yang mi dgos par/ skye ba kun du yang dag bla ma dang / /sogs kyis smon lam btab nas/ spyod lam gyi tshe yang lus don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ phyag dang / bskor ba dang / bla ma'i chu 'chu ba/ shing 'thu ba dang / mkhar las dang / zhing las sogs byed cing / ngag don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ /bla ma'i bstod pa gang shes dang / /snyan grags sogs brjod cing / khyad par du/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so zhes pa ci mang / mi nyung sar skad sang mthon po dang / mang sar chung ngus gsol ba 'debs pa yin la/ yid don yod par bya ba'i phyir/ rang las ma dag pa'i dbang gis 'di ltar du snang ba ma gtogs/ bla ma 'di sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam du yang nas yang du snying gi dkyil du bsgom zhing / de nas longs spyod don yod par bya ba'i phyir du/ gser la sogs pa'i rang gi longs spyod gang bzang bas bla ma mnyes par byed dgos pas/ de ltar na don yod pa bzhi'i sgo nas kyang / bla ma mnyes pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos so zhes bshad cing / de nas slob ma rnams re zhig btang ngo / /'di yan la chos thun cig mdzad la/ de yang gong bsag sbyang gi mjug de ka'am/ de'i sang nyin mdzad pa gang bde byas la/ de nas gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni de'i phyi nyin mdzad pas/ de la thog mar byin rlabs byed pa'i sa der/ gzhi bzang po'i steng du maṇ+ḍal dri bzang gis byugs pa'i khar me tog gi tshom bu dgu bkod la/ de yang dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod pa'i mtshams kyi de rnams bum thod kyi yin pas cung zad chung ba re bya/ de'i mthar byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog shar nas brtsams te chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa rnams khor mor bshams/ gtor ma gnyis kyang bshams shing / slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod sogs phyag len bzhin 'dus byas la/

slob dpon gyis mchod rdzas gnas khang dang bcas pa rnams la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor nas/ oṃ hriḥṣ+ṭi wi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swāhā/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā ba shud+dhoham̐/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid bh+rum̐ las thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta bab bzhis mdzes shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dngas shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar rang rang gi sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la rol chen byas pa'i rjes su/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yang bsgom/ de nas maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu yang sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs byas nas/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can yaṃ dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po'i raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi ri rab gru bzhi pa cog brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma dang / aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/

'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa sogs lan gsum/ de lta bu'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ bh+rum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ rta bab bzhis mdzes shing phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dang / dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing / mda' yab dang pu shus mdzes pa/ dbus phyur bur phub pa'i rtse mor rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mos bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir aṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ de nas gdan de rnams kyi steng du tshom bu bkod par yid kyis bsam la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs dang / oṃ mo han+ta krita hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ si shu nan+ta krita hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rā gan+ta krita hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ir+ṣata krita hūm̐ phaṭ/ slar yang dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu bsnan par bsam la/ oṃ dwe ṣa ra ti nu ta nu ta tru tra tru tra/ hūm̐ dza/ oṃ mo ha ra ti hūm̐ dza/ oṃ pi shu na ra ti hūm̐ dza/ oṃ rwa ga ra ti hūm̐ wa/ oṃ ir+ṣa ra ti hūm̐ dza/ zhes pa rnams kyang brjod la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du ya dang dbyug pa las/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ yum rdo rje ro lang ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ shar du k+ṣe dang dbyug pa las/ gti mug gshin rje gshed dkar po tsartsi ka nag mos 'khyud pa/ lhor ma dang dbyug pa las ser sna gshin rje gshed ser po phag mo ser mo phag zhal can mas 'khyud pa/

nub tu me dang dbyug pa las 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dmar mo dbyangs can ma dkar mos 'khyud pa/ byang du da dang dbyug pa las phrag dog gshin rje gshed ljang khu gau ri ljang sngon mas 'khyud pa/ dpa' bo thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs dkar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ khro gnyer dang / gsus khyim dang / brla dang / brang zhang rnams che zhing sbom la rgyas pa/ sku dang yan lag dang nying lag rnams thung zhing rags pa/ sma ra dang / smin ma dang / dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyis do shal dang / mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan cing / gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pas gshin rje'i tshogs rnams skrag par byed pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de dag gi pang na gnas pa'i yum rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing / g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mgo bo skam po'i phreng bas brgyan cing / gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa'o/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan bzhi brjod la/ shar lhor mu men gyi bum pa bzhi mnyam gyis gang ba/ lho nub tu gser gyi bum pa gla rtsis gang ba/ nub byang du byi ru'i bum pa si ha las gang ba/ byang shar du dngul gyi bum pa ga pur gyis gang ba/ bzhi ka'ang thod pa bdud rtsi gang bas kha bcad pa'o/ /lha de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs dkar hūm̐ sngon po/

thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag nas dbang bskur gyi lha rnams cod paṇa du gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de nas mchod pa bya ba ni sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs byas la/ de'i rjes su/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /sogs kyi tshigs dang / oṃ shri rak+ta sogs sngon du 'gro bas mchod yon nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ rol chen bya/ de nas gos bzung la bdud rtsi gtor te/ oṃ hriḥṣ+ṭi sogs kyis bsang / swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yangs ba/ dngas shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ 'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan na/ /lha rdzas na bzas gang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par bcas te 'bul/ /oṃ shrī rak+ta sogs dang / oṃ badz+ra wasatra swāhā/ de nas yang / 'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan na/ /gzugs mchog tshogs kyis gang ba yang / /zhes dang / gzhan 'dra/ ru pa ka ma gu na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ sgra snyan tshogs kyis༞ dri mchog tshogs kyis༞ zhal zas tshogs kyis༞ reg 'jam tshogs kyis gang ba yang / /bla ma gshin rje gshed po la/ /zhum pa med par bcas te 'bul/ /oṃ shrī rak+ta sogs/

sngon 'gro'i par+ṣe ka ma gu na pu tsi te āḥhūm̐/ 'di rnams la so so'i phyag rgya bca' ba tsam gyis mchog yang / bum pa lto che bre tshad pa/ /mchu 'phyang mgrin ring gdan ldan pa/ /mgrin par ras bza' dag gis dkris/ /snying por ldan pa'i sman sogs bzhug /'dab mar ldan pa'i lcugs ma yang / /bdud rtsir ldan pa yis kyang mchod/ /gzhan yang mchod pa'i khyad par ni/ /bla bre gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / /ba dan sil snyan rol mo yi/ /gus pas dkyil 'khor pa rnams mchod/ /ces brjod cing rol chen bya'o/ /de nas mtheb srin gyis nang mchod gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dbang dang lam gyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag gnang / chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭi sogs nas/ ir+ṣan+ta krita hūm̐ phaṭ gyi bar yab rnams kyi sngags brjod pa'i mjug tu gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'kho+or gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas bya ba'i rgyud sogs dang / shrī mahā ka la sogs kyis chos skyong rnams kyai rdor dang 'dra zhing / gzhan yang phyogs skyong bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ 'jigs byed dgu/ rgyal chen bzhi/ gza' chen po dgu/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad la sogs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po zhes pa nas/ myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig

ces pa'i bar bde kye gnyis dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bstod pa ni rol mo dang bcas pas/ gti mug rdo rje'i rang bzhin khyod sogs kyis bstod la/ gtor chog nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi 'das gtor dang / phyogs skyong rnams la gtor ma phul tshar ba dang / 'di la grangs med pas slob ma du yod khrus byas la 'khod pa dang / chos spyod rnams gong bsag sbyang gi skabs bzhin byas la/ 'dir chos gtor la sogs pa mi dgos/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkram bsdu byas tshar ba dang / 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs zab mo gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje dang / mthu stobs cig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid/ rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa de nyid kyis gdul bya skal ba dman pa rnams bkri ba'i don du lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag ston pa/ yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i gzhung rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang du grags pa dang / skal ba dang ldan pa cig char du 'jug pa'i lam gyi bkri tshul ston par byed pa'i gzhung spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang gnyis gsungs pa las/ 'dir tha mal pa'i rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed par byed pa'i thabs ston pa spros med rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi sgo nas gdul bya zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sa la bkri bar byed pa yin pas/ de la dang por lam zab mo bsgom pa'i snod rung du bya ba'i phyir dbang gis rgyud smin par byas te/ de nas slob dpon 'di'i bzhed pas bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgo nas bkri bar bzhed pa yin te/ glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig tu yang / rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi man ngag 'di ni/ yang dag pa'i bla ma las dbang bskur ba phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i gang zag gis lam nyams su len pa'i tshul/

slob dpon 'di yi dgongs pas bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa 'phrin las dang bcas pa yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i man ngag go /zhes gsungs pas/ de yang bskyed rim sems 'dzin dang bcas pa rnams ji ltar rigs pa sngon du song bar byas nas/ da rdzogs rim shin tu spros pa med pa'i gdams ngag gis bkri ba yin pas/ de la thog mar spros med kyi ye shes ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa bdag byin gyi rlabs pa'i rim pa/ skyes pa brtan par byed pa rgyun gyi nyams len bstan pa/ de la bogs 'byin pa rnam rtog 'od gsal/ de mthar phyin par byed pa sems bskyed pa'i thabs drug de dag gi bar chad bsal ba dang lnga'i sgo nas nyams su len dgos pas/ de yang spyir/ byin rlabs la na ro mkha' spyod dang / zhal gnyis ma sogs kyi byin rlabs rnams ni bskyed rim gyi khrid nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba'i byin rlabs yin la/ gsang 'dus rim lnga'i skabs kyi byin rlabs dang / lam 'bras kyi skabs kyi byin rlabs chung chung 'ga' zhig dang / gshed dmar gyi byin rlabs 'di lta bu la sogs pa rnams ni rdzogs rim gyi khrid nyan pa'i snod rung du bya ba'i byin rlabs yin pas/ des na thog mar bla ma dang gshin rje gshed gnyis su med pa la byin rlabs zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gang gis drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /lan gsum/ de ltar du gsol ba btab nas/ dngos gzhi byin rlabs zab mo bsgrub par byed pa la/

thog mar bla ma la sangs rgyas su nges shes bskyed pa dang / nges shes skyes pa'i slob ma la byin gyis brlabs pa dngos dang / rjes mdzad spyod thams cad sangs rgyas kyi mdzad spyod du shes par bya ba gsum kyi sgo nas nyams su len dgos pas/ des na bla ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa la thog mar bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi nges shes bskyed dgos pas/ de yang dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ sems kyis gzhan ni mi bsam ste/ /sems dpa' chen por mnyam par gyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la/ /rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas/ /dang po sku yi rdo rje ni/ /gzugs phung la ni rab tu bzhugs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pa na/ 'di'i skabs su bla ma bskyed pa sogs ni mi dgos la/ khyed rang rnams bsam pa 'di bzhin mdzod cig bla ma 'di dus tha ma'i sems can rnams kyi don du tshul 'di lta bur ston pa ma gtogs/ don la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo yin te/ gzhung las/ sangs rgyas kun dngos rdo rje 'chang / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston med pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /rten bya sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /dngos grub rgya chen snod du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de yang man ngag gis bsgrub pa ni/ bla ma'i gzugs kyi phung po rnam par snang mdzad/ tshor ba rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'dus shes 'od dpag med/ 'du byed don yod grub pa/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa/ sa'i khams spyan ma/ chu'i khams ma ma ki me'i khams gos dkar mo/ rlung gi khams sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khams rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ spyan byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po/ rna ba phyag na rdo rje/ sna nam mkha'i snying po/ ljags 'jig rten dbang phyug lus sgrib pa rnam sel/ yid 'phags pa 'jam dpal/ tshigs kun tu bzang po/ rtsa byams pa/ phyag g.yas gshin rje gshed/ g.yon pa gzhan gyi mi thub pa/ zhal rta mgrin/

rdo rje bdud rtsi thabs sbyor/ dpung pa g.yas mi g.yo ba/ g.yon pa 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ rje ngar g.yas dbang phyug sngon can/ g.yon pa stobs po che/ spyi gtsug 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ rkang mthil gnod mdzes rgyal po/ gzhan yang gzugs gzugs rdo rje ma/ sgra sgra rdo rje ma/ dri dri rdo rje ma/ ro ro rdo rje ma/ reg bya chos dbyings rdo rje ma ste/ mdor na bla ma ni sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid yin snyam du bsam pa'i sgo nas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'dus shes bskyed dgos pas/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis nges shes bskyed par byas la/ de nas gnyis pa byin gyi rlabs pa dngos la/ zhen pa spangs pa/ byin gyi rlabs nas de kho na nyid la blo bzhag pa gnyis las/ dang po zhen pa spangs pa ni/ /gzhung las/ srid pa'i rtsa ba nyon mongs dang / /bdag 'dzin la sogs ma lus pa/ /zhen pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ltos pa med par gtang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog dang / cod paṇa gyis mdzes par byas pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan zhing / zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pas bdag la dges bzhin du bzhugs pa/ bla ma'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ bsam la/ de nas de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas/ bla ma de nyid de sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam la/

slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ 'phags pa nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ chos skyong bsrung ma rnams spyan drangs te/ bla ma'i mtha' bskor du bzhugs par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ rigs drug gi sems can dang / khyad par du'ang bdag cag rnams la gnod cing lan chags pa'i gnod byed kyi mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rnam pas de rnams kyi mthar 'khod par bsam la/ de nas phyi'i gzugs sgra la sogs pa bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin gyi 'dod yon drug tu mos nas bla ma la mchod par bsam la/ oṃ āḥrū pa badz+rir hūm̐/ oṃ ā shap+ta badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ ā gan+dhe badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ ā par+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐/ oṃ ā dharma dhā tu badz+ri hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod la/ de nas mos gus drag po dang ldan pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes pa rnams ni/ zhen pa spong ba'i yul gsal 'debs pa yin/ zhen pa spong ba dngos la dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig rang gi zhe sdang skye ba'i yul du gyur pa thams cad la/ zhe sdang med cing ltos pa med par bla ma la 'bul snyam pa'i sgo nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzad do/ /bdag gi dgra thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ yang bsam pa gong gi des 'gre/ 'dod chags skye ba'i yul du gyur pa'i gnyen thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /bdag 'dod chags dang༞ bdag gi gti mug skye ba'i yul du gyur pa rang dga' btang snyoms su bzhag pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma dam pa༞ bdag gti mug dang bral bar༞ bdag gi ser sna skye ba'i yul du gyur pa longs spyod bdag po pa'i dngos po ci yod pa thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/

/bdag 'dzin chags ser sna dang bral bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing / mdor na mngon zhen skye ba'i yul phyi rol gyi dngos po thams cad zhe dag pa nas phul bar bsam pa ni/ phyi'i yul la zhen pa spangs pa yin zhing / de nas nang gi yul la zhen pa spong ba ni/ de yang 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ni rang gi nyer len gyi phung po bdag tu 'dzin pa 'di yin pas/ bdag 'dzin skye ba'i gzhi/ rang gi lus 'di nyid bla ma la 'bul dgos pas na/ de la dang por rang dang bla ma gnyis kyi bar du mi mgo'i sgyid bu blos 'khyud tshad tsam pa gsum bsam la/ rang thun mtshams kyi lha dang / nga ming 'di yin snyam du mi bsam par blo tha mal du gnas pa'i ngang nas/ rang gi lag pa g.yas su ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa cig byung nas/ des rang gi thod pa'i dpral ba nas ltag pa'i mdud sgo yan chad thad de bcad la mdun gyi sgyid bu'i steng du dpral ba rang la bstan te bzhag nas/ de stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam pa'i thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba cig tu bsam la/ de nas rang gi lag pa g.yon bcad de dum bu dum bur byas te thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ tshig gzhan rnams 'dra ba la/ rkang pa g.yas pa༞ g.yon pa༞ sked pa༞ ro smad༞ mkhal ma༞ mcher pa༞ mchin pa༞ glo snying la sogs pa'i nang khrol rnams༞ de nas ro stod dang / mgo bo'i lhag ma rnams kyi dum bu dum bur bcad de thod pa'i nang bskyur bas rang nyid sha khrag gi lus ni med cing / rlung sems las grub pa'i nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon lta bu'i gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas dbyug pa dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin zhing / zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ yum dang bcas pa'i skur lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa byas nas/ mdun gyi thod pa'i nang gi sha rus rnams kyang bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs dgos pas/ 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/
