oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dhoḥhaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams kyi steng du/ maṃ hūm̐ traṃ hri a/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lngar gyur/ thod pa'i steng gi nam mkhar 'og nas steng du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de rnams las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ la thim pas/ de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa thod pa'i nang gi rdzas rnams la thim/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ 'og gi rlung g.yos te/ me sbar bas rdzas rnams bzhu zhing skol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ yig 'bru rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang hūm̐ ā la thim/ ā oṃ la thim/ oṃ yang thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hriḥ lan gsum brjod/ de ltar du byin gyi rlabs nas/ mos gus drag po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bla ma dam pas bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod pa ci bde bar bzhes su gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka nas tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhi phyag na thod pa 'dzin pa spros la/ de rnams kyis thod pa'i bdud rtsi nas bcus te/ dang po rtsa ba'i bla ma la phul bar yid kyis bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yang phul bar bsam la yi ge gsum brjod/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas/ bla ma la bdud rtsi phul ba'i mos pa mdzad nas/ yang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / yi dam rnams la yang re re bzhin du thod pas bdud rtsi re bcus te phul bas mnyes nas bdag la byin gyis rlobs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ re re brjod/ yang sangs rgyas byang sems la phul bas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos mnyes nas byin gyis rlobs par bsam la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa lan re re brjod/ de nas 'phags pa nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang / chos skyong bsrung ma la phul bar bsam la/ 'bru gsum brjod/ de nas rigs drug gi sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du yang khyod rang rnams la lan chags pa'i gnod byed mi dang mi ma yin pa yi dam gshin rje gshed kyi skur gsal ba rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing phul bas/ de rnams kyang zag pa med pa'i bde bas tshim nas/ sdig sgrib thams cad dag ste/ gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang la bkod par bsam zhing / mdor na mgron bos pa mgron legs pa bzhin du gyur nas/ de rnams rang gnas su song bar bsam mo/ /de nas mdun gyi rten de rnams la gus 'dud byas pas chos skyong bsrung ma rnams zag med kyi bde ba chen pos mnyes nas/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams la thim/ de rnams sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas yi dam dang / brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la thim/ de rnams kyang zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos thugs mnyes nas 'od du mer te zhu nas/ dbus kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can de la thim pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dam chos kun gyi 'byung gnas/ dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag bstan bsrung kun gyi bdag po yin snyam pa'i mos gus dung pa re mdzod cig de nas byin gyis brlabs pa dngos ni/ gzhung las/ dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma la/ /bsam pa thag pas skyabs song nas/ /lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa gang / /bag la nyal dang bcas las grol/ /sku gsung thugs dang ye shes kyi/ /rdo rje rnams dang dbyer med 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas thog mar sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer sngon po byung /

rang gi snying khar thim pas/ yid kyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag bla ma'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi yid thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i mgrin pa'i ā yig las 'od zer dmar po byung / rang gi mgrin par thim pas/ ngag gi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gsung rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes brjod pas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po byung / rang gi dpral bar thim pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi lus sku rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum byung nas/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgribs bag chags dang bcas pa dag bla ma'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bya byed dang bcas pa thams cad dang / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin ye shes kyi sku dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam la/ de'i ngang la sems cung zad cig mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de nas spros med kyi ye shes ngos bzung ba'am/ de kho na nyid la blo gzhog pa la sems ma yengs par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi rnam par rtog pa'i sems rang rig pa 'di smin mtshams kyi thad nas gyen du mda' gang tsam gyi sar yi ge hūm̐ sngon po cig tu gyur par mos nas/ de la sems cher gtad pas/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu ha la thim/ de mgo bo la thim/ de zla tshes la thim/ de thig le la thim zhing / de yang je phrar song nas/

rim gyis nam mkha'i mthar btegs te/ de yang nam mkha' la thog mtha' med pa bzhin/ sems la thog mtha' med/ nam mkha' la 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi tshugs pa bzhin/ sems glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'jig nam mkhas snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa bzhin/ sems kyis kyang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab/ nam mkha' kha dog dbyibs la sogs pa dang bral ba bzhin/ sems gzung 'dzin la sogs pa'i rnam rtog ma lus pas stong pa ste/ mdor na sems rang rig pa 'di nam mkha' la sprin deng pa ltar yal te song ba'i mos pa mdzad nas/ de lta bu'i spros med kyi ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu zhes brjod la/ dril bu drag tu dkrol te/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams dang / khyad par du mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pas bdag gi slob ma 'di rnams la byin gyis rlabs nas bde chen spros med kyi ye shes da lta nyid du phob cig ces brjod cing / hriḥṣ+ṭi bzlas la/ de'i tshe gu gul gyi dud pas kyang bdug go /de rnams kyis byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi song nas/ de ltar bla ma'i byin rlabs las byung ba'i dbang bzhi'i don/ mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes cung zad rgyud la skyes pa des mtshon pa'i don gyi ye shes de/ tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprod na/ slob dpon 'phags pa lhas/ de ltar 'gro ba ma lus rang gi sems las byung ba ste zhes gsungs pas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad/ rang gi sems la ma brten par byung ba med la/ sems de'i mtshan nyid kyang / slob dpon sgra dbyangs bcu gcig pas/ /sems de'i ngo bo ji lta bu zhe na/ de ni rang rig pa tsam mtshan ma bral ba dmigs su med pa'o zhes gsungs la/ khyad par du 'di'i gzhung las/ 'di ni gsal zhing stong pa ste/ /rig pa de nyid ma 'gags pa/ /rang rig ye shes skad cig ma/ /'dir ni thog ma dbus mtha' med/ /srid med mya ngan 'das pa med/

/bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste/ /'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid/ /'di ni gsal zhing stong pa nyid/ /'di las mtshon te shes par bya/ /'dir ni rang bzhin sku gsum dang / /ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du bstan pa med/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /gzhan du btsal bas rnyed ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de la khyed rang rnams lus bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang ldan par byas nas/ sems gzhan du ma g.yeng par dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ thog mar gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid ces pa/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal tsam/ rig tsam de nyid/ da lta las nyon gyi dbang gis rnam rtog sna tshogs kyi dbang du song nas/ skad cig tsam yang gnas su ma 'dod pa yin pas/ de yang dang por rnam rtog gang skyes pa de sbad kyi bcad nas/ sems kyi mtshan nyid dam/ sems rang gi ngo bo ma 'gags pa/ gsal tsam rig tsam de'i steng du hril te bzhag cing bsgom/ yang stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin zhes bya ste/ de ltar gsal tsam rig tsam de'i ngo bo'am/ rang bzhin du gnas pa de la brtags shing btsal bas/ kha dog dang / dbyibs dang / rtag chad dang / 'gro 'ong dang / skye 'jig la sogs pa gang du'ang ma rnyed cing ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid kyi ngang la sems mnyam par zhog mdzod/ de nas yang bcos min sems kyi ngo bo zhes bya ba sems gsal zhing rig pa de dang / de'i rang bzhin ci yang ma grub pa'i stong pa gnyis po de dbyer mi phyed pa'i zung du 'jug pa yin te/ de yang gsal ba btsal bas ma rnyed pa de kha stong pa/ stong pa 'tshol mkhan de kha gsal ba ste/ gsal ba'i dus na stong pa/ stong pa'i dus na gsal ba yin pas/ de gnyis sus kyang dbyer 'byed mi nus pa de ka sems kyi gnas lugs yin pas/ de'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog pa yin/ de ltar bsgom pas gsal stong 'dzin med kyi bde ba khyad par can gyi nyams skye zhing /

de'i stobs kyis yul snang dngos po thams cad kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log pa ni mnyam bzhag gi stobs kyis rtogs pa yin gyi/ go yul du byas pa lta bu'i tshul gyi rtogs pa ma yin la/ de ltar na de lta bu'i shin tu spros pa med pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa yin pas/ de rnams kyi sgo nas/ byin rlabs ngo sprod dang bcas pa legs par gsan pas/ de lta bu'i man ngag thob nas de'i rgyun bskyangs bar bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ byin rlabs zab mo thob pa'i btang rag tu maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nas brtsam ste sogs byas la/ de ltar na dpal bir+wa pa nas brgyud pa'i gshin rje gshed kyi rdzogs rim shin tu spros pa med pa'i ye shes ma skyes pa bskyed par byed pa'i byin rlabs zab mo gsan pas/ do nub kyi thugs dam de la mdzad par zhu byas la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo / /de nas bla mas bdun gyi dkyil 'khor la mchod/ dngos grub blang / yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang / nong pa bzod par gsol nas/ tshom bu'i ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod/ dge ba 'di yi sogs kyis smon lam btab bo/ de nas de'i phyi nyin rgyun gyi rnal 'byor dang / rnam rtog 'od gsal gnyis ston pas/ de yang me tog bkram bsdu mi dgos shing / gzhan maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yan 'dra bar byas la/ bla mas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i gdams pa khyad par can gsan la thugs nyams su bzhes snyam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa de nyid kyis gdul bya skal ba dang ldan pa rnams zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sar khrid par byed pa'i thabs du ma zhig gsungs pa las/

'dir dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i lam rim pa gnyis kyi sgo nas khrid pa yin pas/ de la bskyed rim gyi chos skor rnams sngon du song bar byas nas/ da shin tu zab pa'i rdzogs rim gyis khrid pa'i skabs su babs pa yin zhing / de la yang spyir gsang sngags kyi lam bskyed rdzogs gnyis nyams su len pa'i tshul 'di la/ dang por bskyed rim la brtan pa ma thob kyi bar la de ka bsgom ste/ de la brtan pa thob nas/ de'i rjes su rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i lugs gcig dang / yang bskyed rim brtan rung mi brtan rung lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bskyed rim bsgom nas gzod rdzogs rim bsgom pa sogs byung na'ang / 'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs pa/ rje btsun sa skya pa rnams kyis bzhed pas/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las/ rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ rdo rje can gyi chos 'chad do/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ thun stod la bskyed rim bsgom nas/ thun smad la rdzogs rim bsgom par bzhed pas/ de yang skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i bar gyi lha lnga'i mngon rtogs sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blangs nas/ de'i rjes su sngar byin rlabs kyi dus su skyes pa'i ye shes de'i rgyun skyongs ba'am/ brtan par byed pa'i don du spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul ston dgos pas/ de la khyed rang rnams sngar gyi bskyed rim de kha'i mjug tu nyams len 'di bzhin du mdzad pa yin te/ de yang hūm̐ rang gi 'dug gnas 'di nyid dag pa'i zhing khams/ gser gyi sa gzhi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi phyag g.yas pas 'jig rten gsum 'dul ba'i dbyug pa dkar po phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing /

g.yon bdud mtha' dag gi khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing / thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal can/ sku lus sbom zhing rgyas pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis ma he dmar po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro lang ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas kyi gri gug nam mkha' la phyar zhing / g.yon thod pa khrag gi gang ba 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing skra grol ba/ gcer bu dbu la phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khril ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba dang / de'i mthar yang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ yang de'i mthar 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba/ de dag gi mtha' skor du yang dpal mgon chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam/ de thams cad kyi mtha' skor du rigs drug gi sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag rnams la gnod cing lan chags pa'i mi dang mi ma yin pa thams cad yi dam gshin rje gshed kyi rnam pas 'khod par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi snying ka nas tsartsi ka la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams spros te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la sogs pa de rnams la mchod par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du dhu pe nas shap+ta'i bar dang / yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ rū pa badz+ri hūm̐/ zhes dang / de bzhin du shap+ta/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ par+ṣe badz+ri hūm̐/ yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing / bla ma la nang mchod phul nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/

zhes brjod/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud gang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyis mchod par bsam mo/ /de nas mchod bya mchod yul/ mchod pa rnams mi dmigs te stong pa 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du gyur/ zhes brjod la de kho na nyid kyis mchod par bsam/ de nas/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi/ /lha rnams la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /bdag ni gzhan la skyabs ma mchi/ /khyed kyis bdag la bka' drin skyobs/ /zhes brjod la/ zhe dag pa'i sgo nas gsol ba btab nas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes gzung du gsol/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes brjod la/ de nas bdag gi dgra thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ gnyen thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral bar༞ btang snyoms pa'i sems can thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa༞ gti mug dang bral bar༞ bdag gi longs spyod bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbul bar bgyi'o/ /'dzin chags ser sna bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod/ de nas rang tha mal par gnas pa'i lag pa g.yas su ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang ldan pa gcig byung bar bsam la/ de nas thog mar rang gi smin mtshams nas ltag pa'i mdud sgo'i bar du sbad de bcad la/ mdun du mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du dpral ba rang la bstan nas bzhag par bsam zhing /

de nas ral gri des rang gi lag pa g.yon pa dum bu dum bur byas te thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de bzhin du rkang pa g.yas pa dum bur༞ rkang pa g.yon pa dum bur༞ ro smad dum bur༞ snying la sogs pa'i nang khrol rnams dum bur༞ ro stod dang༞ mgo bo'i lhag ma dum bur/ mthar lag pa g.yas pa ral gri dang bcas pa yang dum bu dum bur byas te thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ rang rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i gshin rje gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur zhes brjod la/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod pas rdzas de rnams byin gyis brlabs te/ bla ma dam pas bdag gis bshams pa'i mchod pa ci bder bzhes su gsol zhes lan cig brjod la/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de 'dra ba lan gsum/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du༞ de nas yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams༞ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang rgyal rnams kyi༞ cho skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod la 'bul/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mtha' skor gyi rigs drug dang / gnod byed rnams la byin par bsam pas/ de rnams tshim zhing zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang nas rang gnas su song zhing / mthar gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsam mo/ /de rnams ni zhen pa spong ba yin/ da byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la sogs pa de rnams la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ de rnams kyang rim pa bzhin du bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin 'od zer gyi rnam par mer te zhu nas/ chos skyong srung ma rnams nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams la thim/ de rnams sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la/ de rnams yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la/ de rnams brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la/ de rnams kyang 'od du zhu nas rtsa ba'i bla ma de la thim pas/

rtsa ba'i bla ma de dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bor mos pa'i sgo nas/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zhes brjod pas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer byung / rang gi snying gar zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs nas/ rang gi sems dang bla ma'i thugs dbyer med pa chos kyi skur gyur/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma'i mgrin pa nas 'od zer byung / rang gi mgrin par thim pas/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi ngag dang bla ma'i gsung dbyer med pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ dge 'dun la༞ bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'od zer byung / rang gi dpral bar zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi lus dang bla ma'i sku dbyer med pa sprul pa'i skur gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pa la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung / rang gi dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying kha gsum du thim pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med pa ngo bo nyid kyi skur gyur/ zhes brjod nas/ de'i rjes su spros med kyi ye shes mngon du bya ba ni/ lus kyi rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa mnyam gzhag rgal tshigs drang por bsrang / mig 'byed 'dzum med par re zhig ci yang mi bsam par/ nam mkha' la had de bzhag ngag gis steng 'og gi rlung dal gyis bzung / yid kyis lus ni sngar phul zin pas med la/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi sems rang rig rang gsal 'di/ smin mtshams kyi thad nas mda' gang tsam gyi sar yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pa can cig tu gyur par bsam nas/

de la sems cher te gtad pas hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim zhing / nā da de yang je phra je phra la song nas nam mkha' la thog pa med pa bzhin du/ sems la yang thog mtha' med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus med pa bzhin du/ sems la yang mtha' dbus med/ nam mkha' la skye 'jig rtag chad 'gro 'ong med pa bzhin du/ sems la yang skye 'jig rtag chad 'gro 'ong med/ nam mkha' 'dus byas kyi gnod pas mi 'jig pa bzhin du/ sems kyang glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'jig nam mkha' snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa bzhin du/ rang sems kyis kyang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab/ nam mkha' kha dog dbyibs sogs dang bral ba de bzhin du/ sems kyang kha dog dbyibs sogs dang bral zhing / gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa ste/ de yang gsal ba dang ma bral ba'i ngang de ga nas/ sems rang rig pa de nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar/ nam mkhas khyab tshad du sems kyis khyab pas de'i ngang la cham gyi bzhag pas/ rnam rtog dang / rang sems dang / nam mkha' dang / stong pa rnams dbyer med de ro gcig tu bsres la/ stong pa'i ye shes tsam du yang 'dzin med kyi ngang du blo gang gnas gnas kyi bar du 'jog par zhu/ rtog pa'i spun lang du byung ba dang / gzhung las/ chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ /'gro la snying rje rgyun mi 'chad/ /thabs mkhas spyod pa mtha' yas pas/ /yul dang dngos po byed pa po/ /sgyu ma lta bur 'dzin med pas/ /rgya chen bsod nams tshogs la 'bad/ /ces gsungs pa'i smon lam btab nas/ spyod lam thams cad du'ang rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gsal btab cing / de yang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas dge ba'i rtsa bas dus 'da' bar byed dgos zhes brjod/

'di yan la chos thun gcig byas na legs shing / yang na 'di ga'i mjug tu bstan kyang chog pas/ de nas bogs 'byin par byed pa rnam rtog 'od gsal ni/ gzhung las/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /rtog pa'i 'chings ba las grol ba/ /de tshe mchog gi lam rnyed do/ /phyi rol yul gyi 'ching byed rnams/ /bu ga dgu nas snying gar bsdu/ /nang gi rnam rtog zug rngu yang / /spyi gtsug nas ni rkang mthil bar/ /me shel tsam du snying gar dgug /snying kha'i bu ga gsal por dbye/ /skar mda' 'pho ba ji lta bar/ /rgya mtsho'i mthar thug spro bar bya/ /rtog pa'i sems dang bral ba yi/ /lus ni bde ba can der son/ /yi ge gsum gyi gsang sngags brjod/ /mkha' dang rang rig stong pa nyid/ /ro cig mkha' mnyam ye shes bsgom/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /thugs kyi gsang chen bla na med/ /'di ni srid dang zhi las grol/ /blang dang dor ba ci yang med/ /bde dang bde dang sdug bsngal dang / /bdud dang nyon mongs yod ma yin/ /lha dang srin po 'dir med do/ /nad dang sdug bsngal gyis mi gos/ /'dis ni bdud dang nyon mongs 'joms/ /'joms byed bcom ldan 'das zhes bya/ /de las gzhan pa gang yin pa/ /chos kun gnyen por mi 'gyur te/ /thams cad rtog pa yin phyir ro/ /rtog pa'i 'ching bas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas shes na/ /phyi dang nang dang gzhan rnams kyis/ /spros pa'i dra ba rnam par bcad/ /yul gyi 'dzin pa rnam par bshig /rtog pa nyid la gtad legs na/ /rtog pa'i dra ba spong bar 'gyur/ /rten dang brten pa rnam par dbye/ /mnyam par bzhag pa gom par bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ de yang / 'di logs su bsgom na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom nas rang la thim par bsam zhing / de'i mjug tu 'di bsgom la/ /da res rgyun gyi rnal 'byor 'di kha'i rjes su ka ston pas/

de la sngon 'gro de rnams mi dgos pas/ des na dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cig rang la rnam rtog gang skyes pa thams cad dran pas zin par byas la/ 'ubs te bsdus nas rang gi lus kyi bu ga dgu nas hril te nang du bcug la/ rnam rtog de nyid spros med dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam zhing / yang rnam rtog de rang gi lus kyi nang du 'od kyi gong bu'am/ me shel gyi rnam pa lta bu che chung mthe bong tsam du gyur pa de lus kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du yar hril mar hril drag tu byas la/ nang sems byung rnams kyang 'od de la 'jus pas/ de'i 'od zer gyis/ snying dkar nag gi mtshams su skar khung lta bu'i bu ga gsal po zhig phye ste/ rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo/ rang sems spros bral dang dbyer med pa de/ snying kha nas skar mda' 'pho ba bzhin du rgyang ste thon pas/ phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mthar thug gi bar du song ste/ gsal zhing 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam zhing / rang gi lus bem po de las kyi rlung gis bskul nas/ nub phyogs bde ba can der bskyal bas/ 'od dpag med la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur nas/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa phul bar bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa lan gsum tsam brjod/ de nas rtog pa dang bcas pa'i sems 'od kyi gong bu lta bu de la bltas pas de je che je che/ je srab je srab la song bas nam mkha'i mtha' thams cad du khyab pas mthar 'ja' tshon nam mkha'i rang bzhin du thim pa'am/ yal ba bzhin du sems de yang spros bral chos nyid du thim par bsam la/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa ci yang yid la mi bsam par/ gsal stong 'dzin med de'i ngang la cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ de nas rnam rtog gi spun lang byung na sngar bzhin smon lam btab la/ mdor na rnam rtog 'od gsal 'di ni/

spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshe/ sems gnas su ma 'dod nas/ rtog pa 'phro na bsgom pa yin cing / yang 'jigs pa dang / skyug bro ba dang / grib dang / 'dod chags sogs drug gsum dang / sdug bsngal dang / yid mi bde ba sogs phyi nang gi rnam rtog gang skyes kyang / rnam rtog 'od gsal gyis sgo nas nyams su blangs pas/ nyon mongs pa dang / sdug bsngal lam du 'khyer ba'i gdam ngag khyad par can yin zhing / gegs sel gyi mchog kyang yin te/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa'i thabs la'ang / rim gro'i rgyu cha med pa la/ 'di nyid shin tu zab pa yin pas/ de ltar du nyams su len par byed dgos zhes brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo / /de nas gsum pa spros med kyi ye shes skyes pa de mthar phyin par byed pa sems bskyed pa'i thabs drug ni/ gzhung las/ de nas byang chub sems bskyed pa'i/ /bla ma'i man ngag bshad par bya/ /zhes 'byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems ni spros med kyi ye shes pa yin cing / thabs ni bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa drug po yin pas de yang / rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi dmigs pa song ba'i phyi nyin nas mar rim pa bzhin du ston pas/ de yang gsol 'debs nas chos gtor yan gong bzhin byas nas/ bla mas 'dir/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa'i dgongs pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi bcud phyung ba/ rgyud sde dri ma med pa rnams kyi don gyi nying khu/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'jig tshogs su lta ba'i ri bo mthon po bsnyil nas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol bar byed pa'i gru lta bu/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs dpal gshin rje gshed kyi man ngag 'di ni/ yang dag pa'i bla ma la dbang bzhi phyin ci ma log par thob pa'i gang zag gis nyams su len par byed pa la/ slob dpon chen po 'dis bzhed pas/ /bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gi sgo nas nyams su len par bzhed pas na/

de yang bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bskyed pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor bzhi'i sgo nas bsgom pa yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ shin du spros pa med pa'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag rnams yin zhing / de yang bskyed rim gyi nyams len rnams sngon du song bar byas nas/ da rdzogs rim gyi nyams len ston pa'i skabs su babs pa yin pas/ de la 'di rang gi rkang grangs gi dbang du byas na/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ dang por maṇ+ḍal gyis sgo nas tshogs bsag pa/ de'i rjes su yi ge brgya pa'i rnal 'byor gyis sdig pa sbyangs ba/ de nas bla ma la gus par bya ba sogs 'byung zhing / glo bo lo tsā ba'i khrid yig tu/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi /bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par ni mi bya ste/ /zhes pa yar blangs te/ dang por bla ma la gus par bya ba/ de nas rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyis sdig pa sbyangs ba dang / maṇ+ḍal gyi rnal 'byor gnyis bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i khongs su bsdus nas ston par bzhed pas/ de'i lugs ltar na/ thog mar bla ma la gus par bya ba/ bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ rnam rtog 'od gsal/ sems bskyed pa'i thabs dang drug de dag gi bar chad bsal ba'o zhes 'byung la/ gang ltar yang rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi nyams len yan chad song nas/ de'i rjes su spros med kyi ye shes de skyes pa mthar phyin par byed pa sems bskyed pa'i thabs drug la/ thun mong dang / thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po thun mong gi nyams len de la yang / byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor dang gsum/ thun mong ma yin pa la/ srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gsum ste/ de ltar na drug las/

de yang spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshe sems mi gnas pa sogs dang / sgom snying mi 'dod pa dang / gzhan yang dad pa chung ba la sogs pa byung na/ byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom par byed la/ de'i tshe snying rje chung na yang ye shes mi skye bas/ de skye ba'i thabs su mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yin cing / yang de'i dus su snying rje chen po mi skye ba'i khar/ zhe sdang drag po skyes pa byung na/ de'i gnyen por rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yin cing / kha zas la sred pa'i gnyen por rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor dang / 'dod chags kyi gnyen por rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa yin pas/ de la dang po byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ /'og min bde chen der bsgom nas/ /mi phyed dad pas gsol ba btab/ /mthar phyin tshe na rang la bstim/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de la khyed rang rnams lus rnam snang gi chos dang ldan par byas nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas༞ dam pa'i chos༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro bdun la sogs pa ji ltar rigs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o lan gsum/ de nas hūm̐ zhes pas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo/ /sngon 'gro 'di rnams/ mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgom pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe mi dgos pa 'dra yang / glo bo lo tsā ba sogs kyi khrid yig rnams su 'byung bas de bzhin du bris pa yin la/ gang ltar yang de nas rang gshin rje gshed du gsal ba'i spyi bor drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po zhes pa nas/

mgo bo skam po'i 'phreng bas brgyan zhing / gcer bu g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis 'khyud pa'o zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin gsal btab nas/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma brgyud pa/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams spyan drangs nas/ bla ma'i sku'i stod smad bar gsum la thim/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ 'phags pa nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ chos skyong srung ma rnams spyan drangs nas/ bla ma'i sku'i stod smad bar gsum la thim pas/ bla ma de brgyud pa'i bla ma/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsam la/ mos gus drag po dang ldan pas/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag gi rgyud la spros med kyi ye shes skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes pa lan brgya stong la sogs pa gsol ba btab pas/ mthar bla ma de 'od du mer te zhu nas/ rang gi spyi bo na mar zhugs pas/ lus thams cad bde bas rgyas shing / ye shes khyad par can rgyud la skyes te/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par bsam la/ spros med kyi ngang la sems ci gnas gnas kyi bar la mnyam par 'jog pa yin la/ yang shes pa bying na spyi bo bde chen gyi nang du bsgom nas gsol ba btab na grol bar 'gyur zhing / yang lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor bla ma bsgom nas gsol ba drag tu btab na/ gnod pa'i bgegs las grol bar 'gyur bas/ mdor na bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'dis skyon kun bsal zhing / yon tan kun dang ldan pa yin pas/ de ltar du gsol ba rkang gi khong / snying gi dkyil nas 'debs par byed dgos zhes brjod/ rjes smon lam sogs 'dra bar byas la slob ma rnams gtang ngo / /de nas mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor ni/

yang de'i phyi nyin maṇ+ḍal phul ba yan sngar bzhin byas nas/ bla mas chos gtor btang la/ sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la 'dir sems bskyed pa'i thabs drug gi gnyis pa mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ gzhung las/ thog med brtse bas bskyangs pa yi/ /drin can rnams la snying rje bsam/ /gnod byed 'di rnams bdag gi ma/ /sngon tshe phong yang phan btags sbyangs/ /smyon pa bzhin du rang dbang med/ /mi dge las kyis mnar med 'gyur/ /de ltar dran pas srid gsum la/ /snying rje mthar phyin 'gyur ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin pas/ de bsgom pa'i tshul/ de yang rgyu'i snying rje chen po ni/ theg pa chen po'i chos kyi rtsa ba yin pas/ 'di rgyud la ma skyes na/ phar phyin drug la sogs pa gang bsgom kyang theg dman du ltung ba yin pas/ 'di bsgom dgos shing / 'di'i ngo bo ni/ sdug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa/ /snying rje chen po'o zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal las sgrol bar 'dod pa'i brtse ba snying rje chen po'i blo zhig la zer bas/ khyed rang rnams gnas dben par skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang gshin rje gshed du bsgom pa'i spyi bor bla ma sngar bzhin bsgom ste gsol ba btab nas mthar rang la bstim/ de nas snying rje bsgom pa dngos la/ thod rgal pa dgra la bsgom pa dang / rim gyis pa gnyen la bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir thod rgal ba dgra la bsgom pa mchun che ba yin te/ dper na gyad stobs po che lta bu zhig thul na/ gzhan phal cher rang shugs kyi thul ba dang 'dra bar/ dang por gnod pa che shos kyi dgra la snying rje mtshan nyid pa zhig skyes na/ gnyen rnams la rang shugs kyi skye ba yin pas/ de bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ lus sgrim la mig btsum nas yid gzhan du skad cig kyang ma yengs par byas/ rang gi mdun du rang la gnod pa cher byed mkhan gang yin pa de dngos su bsam nas/

bdag la gnod pa'i dgra 'di snying re rje/ snying re rje/ rgyu mtshan gang gi sgo nas snying rje na/ 'di rang gi ma yin pa'i phyir snying re rje/ cis snying rje na/ ma de yang lan gcig ma yin/ lan gnyis tsam ma yin par/ sngon 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ da lta'i bar du yang nas yang du byas pa'i phyir snying rje/ de yang cis snying rje na/ ma nam byas res kyi phan tshad med pa btags shing / gnod pa tshad med pa las bskyabs pa'i drin can yin pas snying re rje snyam du bsam/ de yang cis snying rje na/ de lta bu'i drin can gyi ma yin kyang / kho rang skye shi 'phos pa la brten nas/ ngo ma shes par las ngan pa'i dbang gis bdag la gnod pa 'di lta bu byed pas snying re rje/ des na de lta bu'i gnod pa byas pas snying rje ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin na/ rgyu mi dge ba de lta bu spyad pas/ 'bras bu ngan song du skyes nas sdug bsngal dos drag la yun ring du myong dgos pas snying re rje snyam du zhe thag pa nas mchi ma ma byung gi bar du/ rkang gi khong / rus pa'i gting nas bsgom par byed dgos so zhes bshad cing / de 'dra ba lan gnyis gsum gyi bar du brjod nas bsgom du bcug la/ de la nges shes skyes pa dang / bogs gdon shar 'debs kyi tshul gyis/ rang la gnod pa 'bring byas pa/ /chung ngu byas pa/ de nas nye du/ nye 'brel rnams dang / mthar sems can thams cad la bsgom tshul gong bzhin du byas la/ thun gyi 'phro 'jog na smon lam sogs gong dang 'dra/ chos thun cig go /de'i phyi nyin rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul gyi dmigs pa 'bog pa ni/ sngon 'gro rnams gong bzhin du byas nas/ dngos gzhi la chos bshad kyi tshe/ /'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang mngon du byed pa la/ spros med kyi ye shes khyad par can skye dgos la/ de skye bar byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems yin pas/

de yang gzhung gzhan du smon pa sems bskyed nas bsgom par gsungs kyang / 'dir thod rgal ba'i dbang du byas nas kun rdzob byang sems kyi gtso bo bdag gzhan brje ba nas bsgom par gsungs shing / de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin no/ /de yang slob dpon zhi ba lhas bdag bde gzhan kyi sdug bsngal dag /yang dag brje ba ma byas na/ /sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing / /'khor ba na yang bde ba med/ /ces dang / slob dpon klu sgrub kyis kyang / bdag la de dag sdig smin cing / /bdag dge ma lus der smin shog /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs shing / de dag gi don sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas kyang / byang chub sems kyi gnad 'chugs na/ /chos gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya/ /zhes dang / bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /bstan pa'i snying po yin par gsungs/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyu mtshan du ma'i sgo nas bshad cing / sems bskyed de'i ngo bo ni/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal thams cad/ rang gi bdag 'dzin gyi steng du len cing / rang gi bde dge thams cad sems can la ster ba'i blo cig la byed pa yin la/ de dus gang gi tshe bsgom na/ spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshe/ phyi'i mi bsun pa ni/ phyi'i bar chad dgras gtses pa la sogs pa dang / nang gi mi bsun pa ni/ dug gsum gyi kun nas bslangs te chos min gyi snang ba byung ba na bsgom dgos te/ de yang spros med kyi gzhung las/ phyi nang spros pa mi bsun pas/ /blo gros shin tu 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /bdag dang gzhan du brje ba yi/ /byang chub sems ni dran par bya/ /des ni bdud dang nyon mongs tshogs/ /'joms shing spros med nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de'i tshul la/ rgyun du bsgom pa dang / thog babs su bsgom pa gnyis las/

dang po rgyun du bsgom pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig bdag gi bde dge thams cad sems can thams cad la smin par gyur cig snyam pa yang nas yang du bsgom zhing / sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /ces pa ci mang brjod nas/ mthar sems can thams cad rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gyur par bsam la/ sngar bzhin spros med kyi ye shes ngos bzung nas/ de la mnyam par bzhag cing / bsngo ba bya ba'am/ yang na thog mar de lta bu ci rigs pa bsgom nas/ de ga'i mjug tu/ gnyis pa thog babs su bsgom par bya ste/ de la skyabs 'gro sogs ni gong gi de gas chog dmigs pa la rkyen thog tu dbab pa dang / nad thog tu dbab pa dang / gdon thog tu dbab pa gsum yod pa las/ dang po rkyen thog tu dbab pa ni/ grogs la sogs pas sems dkrugs nas nyon mongs pa che chung gang skyes kyang de ma thag tu bsgom pa ste/ bdag gi nyon mongs pa 'di'i steng du spyir sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa zhe sdang la sogs pa/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa/ 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad nga'i sdug bsngal 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig de rnams zhe sdang sogs sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig bye brag tu dmyal ba tsha grang / yi dwags bkres skom/ dud 'gro glen lkug dang gsod gcod/ lha la 'chi 'pho ltung byed/ lha ma yin la 'thab rtsod/ mi rnams skye rga na 'chi la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad/ bdag gi zhe sdang la sogs pa 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig de ltar smin pa la brten nas ma gyur sems can de thams cad/ zhe sdang sogs nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du rkang gi khong /

rus pa'i gting nas/ rang gi zhe sdang sogs gang skyes pa de ma zhi'i bar du bsgom la/ mthar dgra la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsam zhing / spros med kyi ngang la bzhag rtog pa'i spun lang na bsngo ba bya/ de nas gnyis pa nad thog tu dbab pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs spro na gong bzhin byas nas/ rang gi lus la na tsha che chung gang byung ba'i dus su/ spyir nad bdag gi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad dang / khyad par du ngan song gsum gyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bdag gi na tsha 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig sems can de thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad myur du zhi nas/ bde ba khyad par can dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa dang / de bzhin du gsum pa gdon thog tu dbab pa la yang / lha klu sogs kyi gnod pa byung ba'i tshe de ma thag tu bsgom pa ste/ de yang spyir sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du gnod byed 'di'i sdug bsngal thams cad bdag gi sdug bsngal 'di'i steng du smin par gyur cig bdag gi bde dge thams cad snying kha nas nyi ma shar ba bzhin du song nas/ spyir rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad dang / khyad par du gnod byed 'di'i thog nas/ spyir sems can thams cad dang / bye brag tu gnod byed 'di'i gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad zhi nas/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par gyur cig snyam du zhe thag pa nas bsgom la/ ngag tu yang / sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bde bas 'gro kun bde thob shog /ces pa lan ci mang brjod nas/ mthar gnod byed kyi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob par bsam la/ spros med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /yang rtog pa'i spun lang na/ chos kun stong pa nyid rtogs pas/ sogs dang / khyad par du'ang de lta bu'i nad dang /

gdon dang / gnod pa thams cad ma rig pa'i kun nas blangs te/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba yin/ de ltar du ma gtogs pa'i sems can de rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam nas/ sems can kun gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi dge bas de kun bde thob shog /kun kyang ma rig mun pa rgyun chad nas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'i bsngo ba smon lam byas nas spyod lam la 'jug pa yin zhing / des na 'di ni gang zag thod rgal ba zhig gis nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas pa yin pas/ de yang mdze can dang / gnod pa'i gdon drag pos btab pa dang / rgyal po'i chad pa sogs phog pa'i sar gtad nas/ de rnams la gtong len drag tu bsgom pa yin cing / lung rigs kyis yid ches bskyed pa sogs/ blo sbyong sogs las rgyas po zhig 'byung yang / 'di pa'i lugs kyi dmigs pa 'di rno la 'gril ba zhig yin pas/ spros med kyi ye shes skye ba'i thabs kyi gzhi rten 'di lta bu la 'bad dgos so/ /do nub kyi thugs dam de la mdzad par zhu/ de nas srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la yang / maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba sogs gong dang 'dra bar byas nas/ /'dir rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi dgongs pas/ shin tu spros pa med pa'i gdam ngag gi skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams yang dag pa'i lam du khrid par byed pa la/ rdzogs rim gyi skabs su spros med kyi ye shes skye ba'i thabs drug gsung pa'i dang po gsum song nas/ da bzhi pa srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshul rnams ston pas/ de yang gzhung las/ srog 'gog pa yi sbyor ba yis/ /gom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /bi dar rdo rje rnal 'byor gyis/ /lus ni rnam dag sbyang bar bya/ /zhes pas mdor bstan nas/ dgang ba'i sbyor bas spyi gtsug nas/ /rkang mthil bar du dgang byas la/ /rngub pa'i sbyor bas zhi bar byas/

/dang por bsrub cing bsrub par bya/ /gnyis pa rgya mtsho bskyod pa ste/ /gsum pa gsad pa nor lha gnyis/ /bzhi pa yan lag bskyang bskum 'di/ /phyogs bzhi g.yo zhing srid gsum skrag /ces pas nyams su len tshul rgyas par bshad nas/ 'di yi sbyor ba goms byas nas/ /nad kun las ni grol 'gyur zhing / /'di ltar rgyud dang rgas pa dang / /'chi bdag thag ring kun rtog 'joms/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing / /spros med ye shes go 'phang thob/ /zhes tshogs tshigs bcad gcig dang / rkang pa gsum gyis phan yon bstan pa yin pas/ de la spyir srog ces bya ba ni/ lam 'bras kyi skabs su sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba'i rlung la byed pa yin kyang / 'di pa'i skabs su rlung spyi la zer zhing / rtsol ba ni dran pa ste/ de yang lus can kun gyi srog gyur pa/ /rlung zhes bya ba las kun byed/ /ces dang / gsang 'dus kyi skabs su'ang / rlung ni srog ces bya ba ste/ /rtsol ba dran pa zhes bya 'o/ /zhes 'byung ba yin pas/ mdor na srog ni las kyi rlung yin la/ /'gog pa ni steng 'og gi rlung bkag nas bum pa can bsgom pa yin cing / de'i sbyor ba la gom par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bi dar rdo rje'i rnal 'byor te/ /bi da ra ni rnam par 'joms pa yin la/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ni gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pa yin pas/ mdor na phyi rol gyi bdud dang / nang gi rnam par rtog pa thams cad dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ rlung gi sbyor ba 'di lta bus 'joms par byed/ ces pa'i don yin cing / lus ni rnam dag sbyang bar bya/ /zhes pas ni/ sngon 'gro stong ra bsgom pa bstan pa yin pas/ 'di la sngon du skyabs 'gro sogs gong bzhin mdzad nas/ rang phyi lus kyi dbyibs yi dam gshin rje gshed kyi rnam pa can la/ nang phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i stong sang nge ba cig tu bsam pa ste/

'di zhag bdun du bsgom par gsungs kyang / 'khrul 'khor gyi gong du ci rigs pa zhig bsgom la/ de nas rkang pa skyil krung / lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis brang du bsnol te kha nas ha'i gdangs kyi rlung ro lan gsum 'bud/ yang sna'i g.yas g.yon dbus gsum la dmigs nas/ hūm̐ gis gdangs gis lan gsum bus rjes/ lag pa pus mo gnyis la bkab/ /mgo bo mdun du rgug byas te sna nas rlung dal bus drangs shing lte ba'i 'og tu mnan la mi thub la khad pa dang / slar yang nang du bskyar rngub byas nas bus pa dang / dpung pa g.yas gyen du thogs tshad bteg la 'og tu lhod kyi bskyur zhing / g.yas kyi rlung sems dbu mar sib song bar bsam/ de bzhin du g.yon la'ang 'dra/ 'degs dus 'phongs dang / pus mo gdan las ma bral ba byed/ de ltar lan gsum gsum byed pa ni bsrub cing bsrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa rgya mtsho bskyed pa ni/ rlung 'dzin tshul snga ma dang 'dra bar byas la/ lte ba mdun nas g.yas su bskor te/ rgyab tu rgal tshigs la bcar btang nas g.yon phyogs su drag tu dkrug de 'dra lan gsum g.yon la'ang de ltar bya/ gsum pa bsad pa ni/ rlung 'dzin tshul gong bzhin la/ rkang pa gnyis tsog pu/ lag pa gnyis 'khrig ma nas bzung ste sgom thag gi tshul du byas la/ dpung pa dang gzhog g.yas rgyab tu gcu zhing spang mdun du lhod klod/ de lta bu lan gnyis bya/ yang g.yon gcu ba gnyis/ de nas gsus pa g.yas su bskor ba gnyis/ g.yon du bskor ba gnyis/ 'di dag la lus mi dkrug pus mo phyir phul la/ rgal tshigs rgyab tu 'then pa gnyis/ rgal tshigs phyir phul la/ pus mo mdun du 'then pa gnyis/ dpung pa gnyis gyen du drangs ba gnyis/ 'og tu gdab pa gnyis/ 'di gnyis lhan du byas te/ de ltar bcu drug ste nor lha zhes pa'i don no/ /bzhi pa yan lag brkyang bskum ni/ rlung bzung tshul snga ma ltar byas la/ mgo bo g.yas su bskor ba gsum/

g.yon du bskor ba gsum/ lag pa g.yas mgo la bskor nas dpung pa'i thad kar brkyang zhing dkrug pa lan gsum/ de bzhin du lag pa g.yon pa la gsum/ rkang pa g.yas mdun du dkrug pa gsum/ rkang pa g.yon rgyab tu dkrug pa gsum/ yang g.yas rgyab tu dkrug pa gsum/ g.yon mdun du dkrug pa gsum ste/ rkang pa'i 'khrul 'khor 'di dag lang nas bya zhing / 'di thams cad la rlung mi thub par phyir gtong dus lag pa gnyis pus mo la 'jus nas lus drag tu dkrug cing / sna bug gnyis nas shugs bskyed de bus la re zhig rlung phyir bzung / nang du 'ong dus dal bus sgra mi tshor bar bya/ cung zad ngal gsos te rlung sbyor bskyar nas byed pa'am/ yang na spros med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag ste/ dge ba bsngo zhing / spyod lam la 'jug go /de nas phyis nyin rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor dang / rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor gyi rnam gzhag tsam dang / lam de rnams bsgom pa'i tshe phyi nang gi bar chad 'byung srid pas/ de bsal ba'i tshul mdor bsdus tsam ston pas/ de la slob dpon gyis sngar ltar sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ 'dir grub chen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal bir+wa pa'i gdam ngag zab mo 'di lta bu'i sgo nas gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la bde chen spros med ye shes skyes pa de mthar phyin par byed pa'i thabs drug tsam gsungs pa las/ de yang dang por rgyun gyi rnal 'byor de nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe/ sems mi gnas pa dang / sgyid lugs nas sgom snying mi 'dod pa sogs byung ba'i stobs kyis sgom bsnal ma mi skye na byin rlabs bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ yang de'i tshe dad pa dang snying rje chung nas mi skye na/ mnyam med snying rje'i rnal 'byor/ yang de'i tshe rkyen 'ga' zhig gis sems 'khrugs na rtsa ba rgyu'i rnal 'byor/ yang de'i tshe rnam rtog mang nas mi skye na srog rtsol rlung gi rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa rnams ci rigs par song nas/

rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i tshe kha zas la sred pa na/ de spangs pa'i thabs su rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor dang / tha mal gyi 'dod chags la zhen na/ de bde chen gyi ye shes su bsgyur ba'i thabs rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor dang / lam de thams cad kyi bar chad bsal ba'i tshul cung zad cig ston par byed pas/ de la rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su/ 'dir dmigs pa gral la bsgrigs nas bsgom rgyu zhig med kyang / rnal 'byor pas spros med brtson 'grus drag pa la brten nas/ lus rgud pa'am/ rgas nas lus stobs zhan pa na/ stobs rgyas par byed pa'i bcud len yin pas/ de yang gzhung / dag pa'i gzhi mnyam blangs byas te/ /gla ba yis ni dug med 'gyur/ /gzhan 'dzin dang ni ba ru ra/ /sga skya dang ni lhan cig byas/ /bu ram mar dang sbrang rtsir byas/ /gsang sngags bzlas shing zhag bdun bsgrub/ /dam tshig brtag ldan rnal 'byor pas/ /nang par dus su bsten par bya/ /zhes pas rdzas sbyor tshul dang / de bsgrub nas bsten tshul rnams bstan pa yin la/ de'i rjes su/ skra dkar gnyer ma la sogs spongs/ /dbang po rnams ni mchog tu gsal/ /lus kyi mdog rgyas zo mdog bde/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis byin gyis brlob/ /bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin ni/ /spros med ye shes go 'phang thob/ /ces pas phan yon bstan pa yin pas/ de'i tshul la gsum/ rdzas bsags te ril bu bya ba/ de bsgrub pa'i tshul/ bsten pas phan yon 'byung tshul lo/ /de la dang po rdzas ni/ mar srang bdun tsam/ sbrang dkar srang gsum tsam/ a bar skyur gsum/ sga skya rnams rdog po dgu re/ lung 'khur ma yang a ru ra'i tshod tsam/ ser mu zi srang gang / dngas ma ma nyams shing / sha dang sngo ngad ma zos pa'i bzhi mnyam zhag gsum tsam bsags pa/ de dri chus dug lan gsum bton nas/ rdo leb gtsang ma'i kha ru brdal ba'i mtha' zan nam/

'jim pa gtsang mas bskyor nas/ de'i kha dar dmar pos ma rag tsam du bcad/ rdul dang nyi ma mi 'chor bar bya/ skam pa dang / sngar gyi a ru ra la sogs pa'i sman de rnams kyang zhib par btags la/ de dang mnyam du zhib par btags nas/ sbrang dang bu ram gnyis bsres la bsgar te/ de gnyis dang 'dres par byas shing / mthar de gsum gyis mgo bsdus nas ril bu sha ba'am/ lug gi ril ma tsam byas la/ gla pur bshus byas pa'i rkyal pa srubs med ran pa cig tu blug nas/ rang 'dug pa'i mdun gyi bar snang du btags la bzhag de bsgrub pa'i tshul ni/ de'i mdun du yang gtor ma gnyis dang / chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bshams shing / rang mtshams dam du bcad nas/ bdag bskyed nas bzlas pa yan bya/ gtor chog nas 'byung ba bzhin bzlas pa dang / phyogs skyong la gtor ma phul la/ de nas ril bu de la dmigs te 'bru gsum gsung mi 'chag tu ci mang bzlas shing / de'i rjes su yig brgya dang / ma 'byor ba dang sogs bya zhing / gtor mgron gshegs te/ rjes bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /de 'dra thun bzhi'i sgo nas zhag bdun gyi bar du nyams su blangs la/ bsgrub pa tshar ba dang spros med kyi ye shes skye ba'i phyir du/ snga dro lto stong la bdun re bsten zhing / de nas khye'u gsos byas te gung dang / dgong mo re re tsam bsten pa yin la/ gsum pa de bsten pa'i phan yon ni/ gnas skabs su khams rgyas/ mig gsal/ rig pa dngas/ mkha' 'gro rnams dbang du 'du/ lha 'dre mi gsum byams/ zas gos longs spyod rnams kyang 'bad med du 'byung ba yin cing mthar thug bde chen spros med kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes nas dpal gshin rje gshed kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phan yon yod pa yin la/ da rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gzhung las/ rdo rje 'jigs byed sbyor ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs su mnyes byas te/ /steng gi kun rdzob sna rtse nas/

/sor bzhi bcal nas dbu mar zhugs /nor bu'i bar du srog 'dzin pa/ /steng gi drug pas zin pa yin/ /phyag na rdo rje gzung bya ste/ /g.yas pa'i mthil gyis bum pa sbyor/ /tsak+ṣu gyen du lta bar byas/ /gcig shos yo bar mi bya ste/ /ba thag tsam yang mi 'byung ngo / /gal te phyi rol lhung ba ni/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshar bcad do/ /'og rlung bsdams pas dgra tshogs ni/ /steng rlung mnan pas bdud rnams 'joms/ /dbus rlung dkrugs pas bar chad sel/ /rnal 'byor 'di la sgrub pa pos/ /du ba la sogs mngon shes rnams/ /rnam rtog dra ba ma lus gcod/ /shin tu spros med go 'phang thob/ /ces pas kha ston pa yin la/ 'on kyang 'di ding sang sgom khrid du byed pa'i srol cig ha cang mi 'dug la/ 'dir rnam gzhag tsam zhig ston par byed pas/ de yang gzhung gi rdo rje 'jigs byed sbyor ba yis/ /rgyal ba'i tshogs rnams mnyes byas te/ /zhes tshig rkang gnyis kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi don mdor bstan nas/ de'i rjes su man ngag gi don rgyas par bshad pa ni/ steng gi kun rdzob sna rtse nas/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis sngon 'gro rlung gi sbyor ba bstan pas/ de'i tshul ni/ dang por skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom pa/ rang yi dam du bsgom pa rnams song nas/ lus rnam snang gi chos dang ldan par byas te/ rang gi spyi bo nas nor bu'i bar la/ rtsa dbu ma sbom phra gro sog 'bring po tsam zhig gsal btab/ de nas 'og rlung bskum pas/ rlung rnams smin mtshams kyi bar du song ste/ smin mtshams nas rlung de 'od zer kha dog sna lnga pa'i rnam pas dbu ma'i nang du zhugs par bsam pa dang bstun nas/ steng rlung thub tshad bzung ba la brten nas rtsa dbu ma de 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rang bzhin gyi rlung gis mer te gang bar bsam zhing / de la sems gtad la rlung bum pa can bzung /

mi thub na dal bus sna gnyis nas gtong ba la zer ba yin/ de'i rjes su/ steng gi drug pa zin pa yin/ /zhes pa'i rkang pa cig gis/ de lta bu'i rlung zin pa'i phan yon bstan pas/ de yang steng gi drug pa ni/ /spyi gtsug gi haṃ yin la/ zin pa ni der byang sems zin pa yin cing / de zin pas haṃ las byang sems babs pa de nor bu nas phyir mi 'chor bar rlung gi stobs kyis zin pa zhes bya ba'i don yin no/ /de nas nyams len gyi dngos gzhi ni/ phyag na rdo rje gzung byas te/ /g.yas pa'i mthil gyi bum pa sbyor/ /zhes pa rkang pa gnyis kyis bstan te/ de'i tshul ni/ rang gi lag pa g.yon gyis rdo rje bzung zhing / g.yas pa'i mthil dang bum pa ste/ /rdo rje'i rtse mo sbyar la/ cung zad tsam bskyod pas spyi bo'i haṃ las byang sems nor bu'i bar du phab ste dga' bzhi'i ye shes dran par bya'o zhes pa'i don yin/ de nas rdo rje'i rtser sleb pa dang / tsak+ṣu gyen du lta bar bya/ /zhes pa nas/ ba thag tsam yang mi 'byung ngo / /zhes pa'i bar rkang pa gsum gyis bstan te/ de'i tshul ni/ rang gi mig gnyis gyen du bgrad/ lce rkan la sbyar/ rkang lag bzhi'i sor mo rnams bskum/ lte ba rgal tshigs la sbyor ba ste/ de rnams ni rim pa bzhin/ ro 'dzin rang gi gnas su bskyal/ /zhes dang / gling bzhi rnams kyang dbang du bsdud/ /ces dang / rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar bya/ /zhes pa rnams kyi don yin pas/ spyod lam de rnams kyi sgo nas byang sems phyir ba thag tsam yang mi dbyung bar/ yar zlog pa'i sgo nas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi dran par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin/ de'i rjes su/ gal te phyi rol lhung ba na/ /zhes sogs rkang pa gnyis kyis phyir lhung ba'i nyes pa bstan pa yin la/ de nas/ 'og rlung bsdams pas dgra tshogs zhi/ /zhes pa nas/ shin du spros med go 'phang thob/ /zhes pa'i bar tshigs bcad bris/

de rnams kyi don bsdu ba'i tshul gyi phan yon bstan pa yin te/ de yang 'og rlung bsdams pas 'dzag pa'i dgra 'joms shing / steng rlung mnan pas rnam rtog gi dgra 'joms la/ bar rlung dkrugs pas thig le'i bar chad rnams sel ba yin zhing / gzhan yang lam 'di la nan gtan byas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags lnga dang / lha'i mig la sogs pa'i mngon shes lnga thob cing / de gom pa'i stobs kyis rnam rtog gi dra ba thams cad chod nas shin du spros med kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don legs par bshad pa yin no/ /de nas lnga pa lam de dag gi bar chad bsal ba la/ dang por bar chad kyi rgyu ni/ bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gis bslad pa la brten nas/ de las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / des kun nas blangs te bsags pa'i las rnams yin/ rkyen ni chang 'thung ba la sogs pa tshe 'di'i bya byed thams cad dang / mdor na tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad do/ /bar chad de ngo shes par bya ba ni/ nad gdon la sogs pa gang byung yang / rang gi sems kyi cho 'phrul du shes par bya zhing / sems de yang sgyu ma lta bur rang bzhin med pa'i spros bral nam mkha' lta bur go bar bya'o/ /bar chad bsal ba'i thabs dngos ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su bsdad la/ gnod byed kyi gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad rang gi pha ma drin can du bsam nas skyabs 'gro bya/ rang gi spyi bor bla ma sngar bzhin bsgom/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis bla ma yi dam sogs spyan drangs la bstim pas/ longs spyod thams cad mchod par phul/ gsol ba drag tu btab/ bla ma rang la bstim nas/ spros med kyi ngang la 'jog pa la sogs pa ste/ de yang gzhung gi sgrub po'i lam gyi gegs byed pa/ /bar du gcod pa de sel ba/ /zhes tshig rkang gnyis kyis mdor bstan nas/ phyi rol bdud kyis dkrugs pa dang / /lus dang sems dang rang rig dang /

/nad dang sdug bsngal reng pa yi/ /bar du gcod pa thams cad la/ /sngar gyi man ngag bsgom pa yis/ /mkha' la sprin tshogs 'khrigs pa la/ /mi bzad rlung gis gtor bzhin dag /gzhan yang bdud kyi bar gcod gang / /spros med nyid kyi dbyings su bstim/ /rten dang brten pa so sor bya/ /'dzin pa nyid la gtad par bya/ /de ltar goms pas spros med 'gyur/ /dga' dang bde dang dngas pa yi/ /phyi dang gsang ba mtshon par bya/ /blo yi rtog pa ma zhig na/ /sems bskyed lam gyi dpa' bskyed la/ /til mar ngar btags ral gri bzhin/ /thogs pa med par gzhom par bya/ /shin tu spros med bla ma'i gsung / /blo yi yul du goms na yang / /spros med rtsub mos bskyed pa'i tshe/ /blo la spros med kyis ma reg /blo ni phal pa brtan par gnas/ /de tshe spros pa spros med du/ /ro cig mnyam pa nyid du thim/ /'dre dang srin po 'jigs pa'i tshogs/ /dur khrod ro langs la sogs pa/ /'khun dang ngar ba spyugs pa 'bod/ /'jigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /sems las ma gtogs gzhan med pa'i/ /rang sems skar ma 'pho ba ltar/ /de yi snying la thim pa yis/ /blo dang gzhan dang spros pa rnams/ /spros med ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /yang na blo de nyid la gtad/ /bdag gi gces de mchod sbyin bya/ /mi bzad gdon dang 'go ba'i nad/ /sdig pa'i rmi lam 'pho ba sogs/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gdon la sogs/ /nad dang mya ngan sdug bsngal dang / /dgra dang 'byung po'i gnod pa dang / /mi dang mi ma yin pa yis/ /nye bar 'tshe ba sna tshogs pa/ /thag pa'i sbrul ni spangs pa yin/ /skyug dang gro dang gtsang sbra dang / /'dzems bag dang ni ngo tsha dang / /spros med ye shes kyis gzhom byung / /bla ma 'dod lhar gus bcas te/ /dga' dang bde dang rangs pa dang / /tshim dang nga rgyal dregs pa dang / /sgeg dang tshul 'chos rgyags la sogs/ /spros med ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /zhum dang sgyid lhug mi thun phyogs/

/thams cad spros med nyid du 'gyur/ /mi bzad nyon mongs gang yin pa/ /spros med de nyid las gzhan min/ /de'i bgrod dang bgrod min pa/ /yid du 'ong dang mi 'ong dang / /shin tu spros med sems kyis ni/ /zhen pa nyid du mi bya 'o/ /'jig rten zhing dang mthun pa yi/ /rnam bzhag hrul por bzhag nas ni/ /dgos pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /dpa' bo seṅge bzhin du spyod/ /de la yon tan sogs/ zhes pa nas/ de ltar yon tan phun sum tshogs/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bar chad kyi rgyu dang / rkyen dang / ngo bo ngos bzung ba dang / de sel tshul dang / bsal ba'i phan yon rnams bstan pa'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa yin la/ e ma zhi ba chen po'i chos/ /e ma khro bo'i 'jigs mdzad pa/ /e ma mya ngan 'das pa mchod/ /e ma zhi ba 'khor ba nyid/ /e ma 'di ni rab tu mtshar/ /skyon ni gang yod yon tan 'gyur/ /byang chub med cing mngon rtogs med/ /dngos po min zhing bsgoms pa min/ /khams sbyang min zhing rnam shes min/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs nyid/ /nam mkha' lta bur bdag med pa/ /chos ni bde ba chen po'o/ /sa yang ma yin chu yang min/ /mi min rlung min nam mkha' min/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba yis/ /skye ba 'di la rab tu gnas/ /dngos po thams cad dngos med bshad/ /dngos po med ces ma bsgrags pa/ /rnal 'byor sbyor ba dang 'brel phyir/ /chad pa ma yin rtag ma yin/ /yan lag med cing kha dog med/ /thog ma dbus dang mtha' yang spang / /dngos po thams cad med par 'gyur/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /bsod nams sdig pa dag dang ma 'brel la/ /mchog tu dga' ba dri med dga' ba yis/ /mgon po de bzhin ster chen gcig pu ste/ /kun kyang snying rje'i sems nyid mgon 'di yod/ /chos rnams ngo bo bde ba chen po'i mchog /mchog tu lhan cig skyes dga' ngo bo ni/
